Karla llega a casa de Paco para ayudar con las labores del hogar, pero Miri está molesta, pues su madre es muy fiestera y está celosa. Además, en la fiesta, Karla les da unos chocolates a los invitados.
Brayan y Lucas buscan a una chica para las labores del hogar y contratan a Anastasia, una refugiada ucraniana. Sin saberlo, ella trae a toda su familia a vivir al departamento.
Miranda se va de fiesta con sus amigas y deja a su hijo al cuidado de los hombres de la casa. ¿Crees que entre los tres podrán cuidarlo o necesitarán de una niñera?

Rosita, una de las conquistas de Brayan, se convierte en la nueva ayudante de Paco y su familia en las tareas del hogar. Además, un familiar llega sorpresivamente a la casa y descubre que Toña ya no está.

Toña confiesa que su viaje a Los Ángeles, California, no fue real y cuenta que la migra los alcanzó y tuvo que regresar. Esto hace que la familia se organice para que Brayan se dé cuenta de lo que vale Toña.
Fran necesita dinero, pues Paco ya no le da lo mismo, y Toña le sugiere abrir un solo fans con el rostro cubierto para no ser reconocido. Sin embargo, la nueva novia de Paco intentará chantajearlo.
Paco quiere ligarse a una chica, pero no contaba con que ella es amante de los perritos. Entonces, para que ella caiga en sus redes, él tendrá que aceptar perros en su casa.
Paco consigue un proyecto para la remodelación de una iglesia cercana a su casa. Sin embargo, no esperaba que uno de los requisitos cambiara su forma de vivir.
Paco está deprimido porque una conquista le dijo que ya está viejo. Sus hijos, junto con Brayan y Toña, intentan animarlo con una fiesta temática de los 80, pero Paco esperaba algo diferente.

Fran llega a casa de Paco, su papá, para pasar el fin de semana juntos e invita a una señora a pasar la noche con él. Fran se entera de que Paco tiene una relación con Miranda, su amiga de la universidad.

Rocío llega a casa de Paco y Miranda para quedarse el fin de semana porque se metió un ratón a su casa y están fumigando. Miranda le pide a Paco que corra a Rocío de su casa, pero él le dice que no puede porque es la madre de Fran.

La profesora Margarita va a la casa de Paco para darle una clase a Fran y llega su celoso esposo a buscarla. Paco y Miranda se broncean en la azotea de su casa, pero él se altera porque ella se quita el top.

Paco le inventa a Fran que va a salir a un congreso para tener el departamento solo para él y Miranda, pero ella le dice que su amigo Pascal los visitará todo el fin de semana. Fran llega con todos sus amigos a casa de Paco para hacer una fiesta.

Paco sale con Miranda a un antro, pero la pasa tan mal que la deja sola con sus amigos y ella lo engaña con un DJ. Fran hace una fiesta para animar a Paco, Miranda llega muy borracha e insulta a Monse, una amiga de Paco.

La maestra Margarita llega a ver a Fran con su hijo y le dice que se quedará con él en el departamento de Paco. El esposo de Margarita llega a buscarla a casa de Paco y Toña se hace pasar por su esposa para que no lo golpee.
Paco sigue muy triste por su rompimiento con Miranda y se emborracha. Rocío llega a su casa a pedirle que le aumente la pensión, pero termina bebiendo con él y pasan la noche juntos.
Fran le pregunta a Paco por qué se divorció de Rocío, él le cuenta la historia de cómo se conocieron y que terminaron porque el cantante Manuel Mijares estaba enamorado de Rocío.

Fran y el Borre le piden a Paco que los deje recibir en su casa a una chica que viene de intercambio desde Brasil. Paco quiere cancelar su cita con Monserrat por la chica brasileña de intercambio, pero terminan siendo amigas.
Monserrat le cuenta a Paco que su hermana está muy triste porque terminó con su novio y él le propone que la invite a pasar el fin de semana con ellos en su departamento.

Paco encuentra una prueba de embarazo en el cesto de basura y cree que Fran va a tener un hijo con Lola. Fran le pregunta a Paco si se cuida con Monserrat y le dice que quizás es él que tendrá un hijo.
Paco está muy deprimido porque Monserrat lo dejó. Rocío llega a casa de Paco a pedirle dinero para pagar las clases de educación física a Fran y le aconseja que busque una mujer de su edad.
Fran invita a Xóchitl, una mujer a casa de Paco, primero lo regaña por meter gente desconocida al departamento, pero cuando ve la foto le dice que la llame.
Paco se deprime por el robo a su departamento y le pide prestado los muebles a Roció. Llegan nuevas vecinas al edificio y Fran se queda atrapado en el ascensor con una de ellas.
Paco recupera los muebles de su casa. Ahora Toña está triste porque no aparece su perfume "Ven a mí", traído desde Oaxaca.
Fofo, el hermano de Paco, llega de visita a México, sin esposa y acompañado de una pareja un poco particular.
Macarena está por casarse y no tiene dónde hacer su despedida de soltera. Paco le ofrece su departamento para el festejo.

Rocío le reclama a Fran por tener que ir a recogerlo a la cárcel. Fran le cuenta a Rocío cómo terminó en la cárcel. Doña Ruperta, la vecina de Paco, le reclama porque ningún vecino pudo dormir por la fiesta que hizo. Los vecinos de Paco hacen una junta.

Paco se va de viaje y Fran encuentra la oportunidad perfecta para ganarse unos dólares alquilando el departamento de su papá a unos viejitos por el fin de semana; unas horas más tarde el vuelo de Paco se cancela.
Fran acaba de conocer a Karime y se enamora perdidamente de ella. Solo hay un pequeño problema: Karime se casa el próximo fin de semana.
Paco acompaña a Fran a la boda de Karime y se encuentra con Emilia, una exalumna que reprobó en la universidad.
Paco es despedido de la universidad por el escándalo que se generó por Emilia y todas sus mujeres le reclaman.
Paco está muy triste porque lo despidieron de su trabajo por culpa de Emilia. Fran se enamora de Silvana, su psicóloga, y termina seduciéndola.
Paco regresa con Miranda, su exnovia, y la lleva a vivir a su casa. Todo va bien hasta que llega Lorena y el mundo se le viene abajo.
Paco acepta a ir a terapia con mucha gente extraña por su adicción a las mujeres jóvenes. Miranda descubre que Paco les paga a mujeres jóvenes para tener intimidad con ellas.
Paco organiza una fiesta e invita a todas las mujeres que le gustan, pero ninguna asiste y termina borracho con los amigos de Toña.

Chio les cuenta a Paco, Fran y Toña que Víctor la dejó porque aceptó ser amiga de un hombre que conoció en una red social. Chio trata de convencer a Paco de pagar un increíble viaje para que ella pueda encontrar al hombre perfecto.
La tía de Fran se muda al mismo edificio que él para cuidarlo. Chayo obliga a Fran, Paco y Toña a seguir todas las reglas que quiere.
Paco organiza unas elecciones vecinales para cambiar la administración del edificio; los candidatos son La Delegángster, Paco y Toña, la representante del pueblo.
Paco les dice a Toña y Fran que planea empezar una vida saludable para conquistar a una hermosa mujer que vio en un gimnasio.
Fran lleva a una mujer mayor que él a su casa y esta se pone nerviosa al conocer a Toña y Paco. Toña cree que los horóscopos son reales y que por eso Fran conoció a Estrella.
Fran regresa de su viaje de generación con una noticia, se ha casado en La Habana con Yusnavis, una espectacular cubana, a quien ha traído a vivir a México.
Una de las alumnas de Paco lo visita y se pone borracha con él, su padre va a buscarla y él culpa a Fran de pasar la noche con ella.
Martina, una mujer muy hermosa, organiza una fiesta para Toña y le pide a Paco pagarla, él acepta, pero después se arrepiente.
Después de una larga planeación, llega el día de la celebración de los XV años de Toña y lo que debía ser una fiesta tradicional y emotiva acaba en un verdadero pandemonio.
Fran falsifica la firma de Paco para usar su departamento. Paco conoce a una hermosa actriz y trata de conquistarla.
Fran cree haber matado a una mujer mayor y le pide ayuda a su familia para no ir a prisión, pero sus mentiras los meten en un gran problema.
Beto, el primo de Paco, llega al departamento y le pide quedarse, ya que su esposa, Julia, lo echó de la casa.
El primo Beto es un bruto encantador. Paco y Fran le advierten a Toña que la está engañando, pero ella cree que le dicen eso porque están celosos.
¡Los Cossio tienen visita! Llega la familia de Toña y como ella les contó algo diferente a la realidad, Paco tiene que fingir ser su novio. A Fran le toca el papel de mayordomo.

Paco llega al departamento con Meche, una amiga, y ella les propone ir a un desnudo masivo en las pirámides de Teotihuacán para unas fotos. Les promete que es una experiencia única, mágica. Toña es la única que no se anima.
El sobrino de Paco, Jacobito, llega a pasar unos días con ellos porque está de vacaciones. Sin embargo, no deja a Paco estar a solas con su novia Mayra, y hasta duerme con ellos.
Paco llega asustado a su casa con una amiga, y le cuenta a Toña y a Frank que asaltaron el banco. Su amiga esconde un secreto.
Toña le mete en la cabeza a Paco que la nueva novia de Frank es hombre, él asombrado le pide que no los deje solos.

Jacinta, mamá de Tecla, ha llegado con la intención de quedarse. Don Arnoldo no quiere que se quede, y Plácido le permitirá ser parte de la familia. Como le harán para que el administrador no encuentre el hoyo en la pared.
Doña Romina escucha ruidos extraños en el departamento que ha invadido la familia López, en el que murió don Genaro el mes pasado. Por eso, doña Romina cree que un fantasma habita el lugar.
Con todas las medicinas que dejó Licha, Justito y Victoria crean un compuesto químico que Plutarco se toma por accidente. La Nena finge estar enferma para quedarse con el cuarto de Gaby.

Plácido no encuentra empleo, por lo que prefiere quedarse cómodamente en su sofá, al igual que hace su padre. Plácido exige a los miembros de la familia que atiendan todos sus deseos para no levantarse del sofá, y ellos ya no lo soportan más.
Plácido tiene la posibilidad de recuperar su antiguo trabajo; pero don Justo le señala que ese puesto vacante solo es para Adolfo. Plutarco trabajará como sujeto de prueba de productos milagrosos.
Plácido acaba de recordar que es su aniversario de bodas con Renata, por lo que le organizará una cena romántica. Martina invita al cine a la familia a ver el estreno de una película.
Adolfo pierde el bono huachicolero por bañarse, y con la ayuda de Jacinta se convierte en hierbero. Carlos recibe regalos de un admirador secreto.

Plácido se lastima el pie y debe guardar reposo de un mes, por eso enviará a Adolfo a que recupere su trabajo. Martina hace un hoyo en la pared y la Nena descubre, a través de este, un departamento abandonado.

A New York City author heads off to Montana after inheriting her family's dilapidated ranch. She soon gets more than she bargained for when she meets a charming cowboy who challenges her big city ideals.

An ambitious reporter tracks down a prince who is in town for the dedication of a naval museum honoring his late grandfather. She convinces him to show his followers that his work is more than just a job, and the two begin to fall for each other.
Despite a trial separation, Lauren pretends to still be with her husband, Kevin, to placate her overbearing mother. The ruse may be just what the couple needs to finally work on their marriage.

A retired musician hatches a plan to bring his three daughters home for Christmas for the first time since their mother's death. Holiday songs and old memories soon make the estranged siblings realize that life is better when they're all together.

When vintage fashion devotee Caro Cartwright agrees to harbor her childhood nemesis turned couture heiress Philippa Levreaux, fireworks explode. They soon help each other with meeting challenges, being their best selves, and fulfilling their dreams.

In this animated musical, the villainous King Haggard (Christopher Lee) plots to destroy all the world's unicorns. When a young unicorn (Mia Farrow) learns that she's in danger and that she may soon be the last of her kind, she leaves the safety of her protected forest and enlists the help of Schmendrick (Alan Arkin), a gentle, albeit clumsy, sorcerer. Together, they embark on a long and dangerous journey with one goal: to defeat Haggard and save the unicorns from extinction.

Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

A comedic send-up of the grim circumstances of the Middle Ages as told through the story of King Arthur and framed by a modern-day murder investigation. When the mythical king of the Britons leads his knights on a quest for the Holy Grail, they face a wide array of horrors, including a persistent Black Knight, a three-headed giant, a cadre of shrubbery-challenged knights, the perilous Castle Anthrax, a killer rabbit, a house of virgins, and a handful of rude Frenchmen.

Imprisoned on a drug charge, mobster Jack DiNorscio refuses to testify against his former associates in the Lucchesi crime family. When an ambitious prosecutor brings him back to court, he decides to defend himself. Initially regarded with disbelief, his forceful presence and knowledge of the law turn the tide of the trial.
Determined to help at-risk youths avoid the mistakes he made, an ex-con (Cuba Gooding Jr.) forms a chess club to offer them an alternative to running with street gangs.

Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity.

He sets out to try to find a shard of the dark crystal, a powerful gem that once provided balance to the universe. After the crystal was broken, the evil Skeksis used sinister means to gain control. Jen believes that he can repair the dark crystal and bring peace back to the world, if he can only find the remaining shard.

Crysta is a fairy who lives in FernGully, a rainforest in Australia, and has never seen a human before. In fact, she is told they are extinct. But when a logging company comes near the rainforest, she sees that they do exist, and even accidentally shrinks one of them: a boy named Zak. Now her size, Zak sees the damage that the company does and helps Crysta to stop not only them, but an evil entity named Hexxus, who feeds off pollution.

On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

When the iron-fisted ruler of a small African nation dies, his top aide, Roberto Strausmann (Raul Julia), will do anything to avoid a regime change, so he recruits struggling film actor Jack Noah (Richard Dreyfuss) to pose as the deceased political leader. Jack looks just like the man he's portraying, and, with Strausmann's expert instruction, he successfully fools the world. But as Jack falls for ravishing humanitarian Madonna Mendez (Sônia Braga), he decides to use his influence for good.
An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.
Movie, Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy

Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

Christine Brown has a loving boyfriend and a good job at a Los Angeles bank. Her heavenly life becomes hellish when, in an effort to impress her boss, she denies an old woman's request for an extension on her home loan. In retaliation, the crone places a curse on Christine, threatening her soul with eternal damnation. Christine seeks a psychic's help to break the curse, but the price to save her soul may be more than she can pay.

A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

The dashing, mysterious Count Dracula (Bela Lugosi), after hypnotizing a British soldier, Renfield (Dwight Frye), into his mindless slave, travels to London and takes up residence in an old castle. Soon Dracula begins to wreak havoc, sucking the blood of young women and turning them into vampires. When he sets his sights on Mina (Helen Chandler), the daughter of a prominent doctor, vampire-hunter Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan) is enlisted to put a stop to the count's never-ending bloodlust.

A man washes ashore in England after a shipwreck and is found by Mina Van Helsing (Jan Francis). The man introduces himself as Count Dracula (Frank Langella) of Transylvania, and proceeds to integrate himself into the lives of Mina and her friend Lucy Seward (Kate Nelligan). However, when Mina dies and her father, Prof. Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier), attributes her death to a vampire, evidence indicates that Count Dracula is the monster, and Lucy is his next target.

Soon after beginning work for Conde Dracula (Carlos Villarias), the clerk Renfield (Pablo Alvarez Rubio) learns that his employer is, in fact, a vampire who lives on human blood. Now under Dracula's spell, Renfield helps his master travel to London, where the vampire takes another victim (Carmen Guerrero). Dracula also has eyes on the lovely Eva (Lupita Tovar), but her fiancé, Juan Harker (Barry Norton), and a wise professor named Van Helsing (Eduardo Arozamena) seek to stop him.

Although Count Dracula was destroyed by Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan), who is now being tried for his murder, Dracula's daughter, the Countess Marya Zaleska (Gloria Holden), is still alive -- and her father's death has brought her no closer to eradicating her vampiric thirst for blood. When attempts to free herself of the disease fail, she turns to psychiatrist Dr. Garth (Otto Kruger) for assistance, but soon finds herself struggling with the desire to make him one of the undead as well.

Dr. Frankenstein (Peter Cushing) returns destitute to his home village to recommence his experimental research into the reanimation of dead tissue, and stumbles upon his old monster suspended in ice. Though he revives the creature, Frankenstein must seek the help of hypnotist Zoltan (Peter Woodthorpe) to repair its mind. Zoltan then assumes control of the monster, using him to wreak havoc. But when Frankenstein tries to regain power over his creation, he becomes Zoltan's next target.

This iconic horror film follows the obsessed scientist Dr. Henry Frankenstein as he attempts to create life by assembling a creature from body parts of the deceased. Aided by his loyal misshapen assistant, Fritz, Frankenstein succeeds in animating his monster, but it escapes into the countryside and begins to wreak havoc. Frankenstein searches for the elusive being and eventually must confront his tormented creation.

Lawrence Stewart Talbot (Lon Chaney Jr.) is plagued by a physical oddity that turns him into a crazed werewolf after sundown. His desire to rid himself of this ailment leads him to the castle owned by mad scientist Dr. Frankenstein. Frankenstein, it turns out, is now dead, yet Talbot believes that the scientist's daughter, Baroness Elsa Frankenstein (Ilona Massey), can help him. However, his quest to right himself puts him on a collision course with Frankenstein's monster (Bela Lugosi).

When famous radio hypnotist Alex Gregor (Lon Chaney Jr.) accidentally causes the death of an audience member during a broadcast, his guilt leads him to break off his engagement to Maura Daniel (Evelyn Ankers) and take a job at a wax museum. Jealousy over the attention paid to his new co-worker causes mentally unbalanced sculptor Rudi Poldan (Martin Kosleck) to lash out at museum owner Valerie Monet (Tala Birell) and her niece Nina (Elena Verdugo) in a horrifying fashion.

Rebellious teen Amy (Elizabeth Berridge) defies her parents by going to a trashy carnival that has pulled into town. In tow are her boyfriend, Buzz (Cooper Huckabee), and their friends Liz (Largo Woodruff) and Richie (Miles Chapin). Thinking it would be fun to spend the night in the campy Funhouse horror ride, the teens witness a murder by a deformed worker wearing a mask. Locked in, Amy and her friends must evade the murderous carnival workers and escape before it leaves town the next day.
Shepherd Igor rescues the monster from a sulfur pit and brings him to Dr. Frankenstein's other son.

After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie (Jamie Lee Curtis) and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), Michael Myers (Jonathan Prince) has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.

This monster movie focuses on the iconic vampire, Count Dracula (John Carradine), and Lawrence Talbot (Lon Chaney), better known as the Wolf Man. Both beings of the night are tired of their supernatural afflictions, so they seek out Dr. Franz Edelmann (Onslow Stevens) for cures for their respective curses. While trying to aid the imposing creatures, Edelmann himself develops a transformative condition, adding to the many ghouls lurking around the foreboding landscape.

After escaping from prison, the evil Dr. Niemann (Boris Karloff) and his hunchbacked assistant, Daniel (J. Carrol Naish), plot their revenge against those who imprisoned them. For this, they recruit the powerful Wolf Man (Lon Chaney), Frankenstein's monster (Glenn Strange) and even Dracula himself (John Carradine). Niemann pursues those who wrong him, sending each monster out to do his dirty work. But his control on the monsters is weak at best and may prove to be his downfall.
An insane sculptor sends the disfigured criminal he saved from drowning to kill the critics who denounced him.

While on a boating trip, Scott Carey (Grant Williams) is exposed to a radioactive cloud. Nothing seems amiss at first, but several months later Scott realizes that he's shrunk in height by several inches. He sees a doctor, who admits that he's baffled. As Scott continues to shrink, decreasing to three feet tall, he becomes bitter, and lashes out at his wife, Louise (Randy Stuart). He begins to fear a cure will never be found -- since even as he becomes a national sensation, he's still shrinking.

While researching a new drug, Dr. Jack Griffin (Claude Rains) stumbles on a potion that can make him invisible. When he reveals his new ability to his old mentor (Henry Travers) and his fiancée (Gloria Stuart), it's clear that a side effect of the potion is insanity. Jack goes on a violent rampage, and the police struggle to hunt him down, unable to see their target, while his mentor and his former partner (William Harrigan) desperately try to devise a plan to capture him.

Wrongly accused of murdering his brother, Geoffrey Radcliffe (Vincent Price) is found guilty and sentenced to die. But when sympathetic Dr. Griffin (John Sutton) injects him with a serum that renders him invisible, Radcliffe is able to escape and search for the real culprit. With Inspector Sampson (Cecil Kellaway) of Scotland Yard hot on his trail, Radcliffe begins to suspect that a recent hire in his family's mining company might have the answers he seeks.
Viva de milagro y huyendo de Baltasar Ojeda, la Doña llega a México y se une a Amado para enfrentarlo, poniendo en riesgo a los Casillas. El Chema se propone desenmascarar al doble de Aurelio.
Amado decide salir a un operativo con la Doña y Diana, pero ella decide no ir. Altagracia manipula a Águila Azul. Anaya comete otro crimen.
En medio del operativo para cazar y matar al enemigo que tienen en común, Altagracia seduce a Amado. Diana llama a su familia para advertirles que redoblen la seguridad.
La DEA reparte diez millones de dólares por la captura de Aurelio Casillas y el Cabo; pero Ismael triplica la cifra y garantiza la lealtad al Señor de los Cielos. Esther combatirá al narco.
Leonardo reaparece en Playa del Carmen y confiesa que huyó de Sinaloa, donde vivía con el Chema Venegas, su padre. Amado negocia con Maldonado a cambio de información.
El cabo y los Casillas se enfrentan a balazos. Ismael somete a Milton Jiménez y le apunta a la cabeza. Maldonado burla la seguridad y desafía al árabe. El Chema va a por su hijo Leonardo.
Tras la aparición de Leonardo, los Casillas se preparan para enfrentar al Chema y piensan en el Rojo, como uno de los suyos. Debe decidir de qué lado se queda en esta guerra.
Aunque sus hombres le recomiendan mantenerse bajo perfil, el Chema decide ir a buscar a Leonardo. El Rojo se queda con los Casillas.
La casa en Tijuana ofrece las mejores condiciones para ocultar a Aurelio, por los túneles que tiene. Amado ordena a Diana que agilice la mudanza con los Casillas. Arrestan a Casasola.
Para ubicar a Casillas, el Chema somete a Corina, pero ella se resiste a ayudarlo. Valdés y el árabe tienen listo el proyectil para el ataque terrorista a EE. UU.
Con la familia Casillas ya instalada en Tijuana, Diana y Amado disfrutan de una noche sin precedentes: el amor crece y promete ser duradero. Aurelio, aún en coma, podría oír lo que los demás dicen.
Mientras Amado se prepara junto a todos sus hombres para detener el ataque terrorista a Estados Unidos, Aurelio se mueve inesperadamente, cuando reconoce la voz de Corina. Casasola miente.
Los árabes eliminan al espía de los Casillas. Amado descifra el mensaje del asesino, que le da claves del lugar del ataque terrorista, y lo amenaza de muerte.
Tras sufrir un golpe de estado, Terán huye de Los Pinos y contacta al Cabo. Él lo busca en su avión privado y le exige la libre entrada a sus gatilleros. Amado deduce el blanco de los árabes.
Los Casillas sorprenden a los árabes. Rescatan a Casasola y Maldonado y encierran al cabecilla. Impiden que un misil impacte en EE. UU. El Chema se adueña de las narcotienditas en México.
Luego de dos emboscadas, explosiones y tiroteos, Amado enfrenta a Baltazar Ojeda. Milena besa a Rutila. Los Casillas secuestran a Anaya. El Pulque está feliz con Alba.
Después de muchos años, el Chema se reencuentra con Rutila y trata de seducirla. Diana espera el ataque de los colombianos y Amado decide asistirla en el operativo.
Por aire y por tierra, Amado y Diana defienden con armas y granadas el rancho Ahumada. Rutila le dice al Chema que debe consultar con la familia si quiere hacer un pacto que acabe con el Cabo.
La Doña lavará la fortuna de los Casillas a través de sus empresas constructoras. Diana, renuente, termina aceptando que trabaje para ellos. Carla denuncia a Terán y él manda a matarla.
Rutila debe convencer a su familia de que la alianza con el Chema es una buena idea. Además, pelea con Javi al saber que estuvo con su ex.
Para declararle la guerra a su enemigo en común, el Cabo, los Casillas pactan con el Chema. Javi estará al mando. La fiscal evita que la secuestren junto a Carla. Terán emprende su huida.
Castillo pone a Terán tras las rejas y le jura que pagará por todos sus crímenes, en especial, por el de Mayra, su novia. El Cabo embaraza a sus mujeres y ambas se niegan a tener los bebes.
Para proteger al cartel de Casillas, Amado se entrega a la justicia con la condición de ser procesado en México. Diana promete sacarlo de prisión. El Cabo huye.
Mientras Doña Alba lucha por revivir a Aurelio, los Casillas se apoderan de la ciudad para intentar liberar a Amado. Se alían con enemigos para enfrentar a los gobiernos de México y EE. UU.
El Gobierno tiene rodeados a los Casillas, pero ellos no son presa fácil y les muestran a quienes pretenden eliminarlos que son indestructibles. Pío trama su venganza contra Súper Javi.
El rescate de Amado falla y el Gobierno americano lo traslada a EE. UU. Los Casillas vuelven al ataque con un plan de fuga, pero el operativo es de alto riesgo. Javi recibe noticias inesperadas.
Pío José Valdivia, el enemigo más peligroso de los Casillas, comienza a ejecutar su venganza para eliminarlos uno por uno. El primero en su lista es Súper Javi; él se prepara.
Amado y Diana llegan a Grecia en busca de nuevos aliados para fortalecer el Cartel de los Casillas. Pero la mafia de Los Balcanes tiene otras intenciones. Pío y Jaime buscan la presidencia.

Johnny and Jenny search for a luxury home; taking them through some beautiful mega mansions in Los Angeles, Calif.; they need a house with the perfect entertaining space.
George and Bill are looking to cut their commute and move to the city; they visit some desirable properties in Palo Alto, Calif.
John is ready to trade in Bay Area living for the beach and visits three properties in Orange County, Calif.

When Lee notices the character on Gaara's forehead has changed from "Love to Romance," he's convinced the Kazekage's got a crush on someone; Lee gets a booby-trapped watch from Orochimaru that will explode if he stops training.

Lee's convinced the upcoming dodgeball tournament is just going to be a silly kids game, until a few choice words from Guy sensei light a fire in his soul; Kabuto sets out to prove he's better than his former boss by joining Lee's team.

Lady Tsunade wins the lottery jackpot and promises to take Lee and the gang out for five-star sushi; Iruka sensei's had enough with his disobedient students, so Lee and the gang go to the Academy to put on a show.
Naruto, Lee and the others go out hunting for matsutake mushrooms, but there are none to be found after an unusually hot summer; Neji's had enough of being forced to cross-dress for Lee's skits.
Gaara's on his way back to the Leaf Village, and Team Guy scrambles to make sure he feels welcome; the girls beg Guy Sensei to train them.

Lady Tsunade sets out to teach her charges the importance of safety after many ninja keep getting injured due to carelessness; Lady Tsunade puts Lee and the gang in charge of the village's Halloween celebration.

Guy Sensei gives the gang a rare break, but will they end up being terrorized by Orochimaru's Orochi Hot Springs trap?; Orochimaru realizes his birthday, October 27th, came and went without anyone noticing.
Lee fakes being sick so that Sakura will be his nurse, only to find that his rival in love is using the same tactic; Sasuke won the last popularity contest, while Lee wasn't even on the board.
When Orochimaru's poison leaves Guy Sensei completely bald, it's up to Lee and the gang to find him the right wig; the narrator comes down with a bad cold.

When Naruto's favorite ramen stand, Ichiraku, comes up against hard financial times, Lee tries to help the restaurant; Tenten and Neji try to get their hardworking teammate to actually use his vacation time to rest.
Owing them all many thanks, Lee tries to bond with all of his comrade's Animal Summons; with so many romantic holidays occurring in winter, Hinata aims to grow a little closer to Naruto.
An encounter with the Sand siblings turns ugly when Temari insults Tenten; Orochimaru starts longing to [LIVE] a normal life after being barred from entering a family-friendly market.
When Tsunade leaves on a diplomatic mission to a neighboring village, she leaves the only shinobi who wasn't busy, in charge - Guy; Team Guy is assigned to go on patrol with Shikamaru's team.
Lee's team stumbles upon Akatsuki's hidden base; Deidara is determined to chase them away before the rest of his teammates learn about his history with the dedicated ninja.

The Hidden Leaf Village throws a big Christmas party; there are many shinobi competing for one another's affections, so the Secret Santa can turn into a survival battle; it's time for the yearly cleanup.
Lee and the gang catch the adults participating in a tournament; Neji decides to observe Naruto and determine if the orange ninja is worthy of Hinata's affections.

Trapped by Orochimaru's blizzard, Lee and the gang fight to stay warm; popping out from the First Hokage's nostril is Rock Lee, from 30 years in the future, who has come back to give his young self a helpful robot.
Shino's bugs refuse to leave his body because the weather's too cold, so Lee and his pals help him search for replacements; A maiden's battle ensues on the floor of a department store!
When the team gets assigned to infiltrate an illegal chakra-trading ring, Lee goes to Sai for advice; a nefarious scoundrel keeps leaving the village bathrooms a filthy mess.
Lee's team gets to play ogres for the annual Setsubun festival, but Orochimaru schemes to ruin the fun; Lee and his friends have to team up with Killer Bee to protect the Hidden Cloud.
When the freezing cold leaves Lady Tsunade feeling down, the village organizes a snow-sculpting contest to cheer her up.
Jiraiya trains Lee, Naruto and Konohamaru; Tsunade takes Sakura and the girls to the hot springs and chaos ensues.
Kiba enlists Hinata and the girls to find Akamaru some canine companions; Lee and his team run into Sasuke on their way back from a mission.
Captain Yamato leads Lee, Tenten and Sai on a mission to recover a stolen scroll; Orochimaru creates a virus that turns humans into "Oro-Zombies."
It's the day before White Day, and a sinister trio of villains has ruined the village supply of sweets; A prankster keeps putting the dolls back after the Doll Festival ended.
Somehow Guy is reverted into a baby and Lee uses this opportunity to prove that he's a grown-up; Lee invites Tsunade to a marriage interview and Tsunade tries everything to make it all go downhill.
The time for the final battle against Sasuke is now; Lady Tsunade assigns Lee's team with an S-Ranked mission: prepare a cherry blossom viewing party.
Deadly ninja roam the land and the mischievous Naruto Uzumaki causes trouble.
Naruto graduates from the Ninja Academy.
Naruto must team up with Sakura and Sasuke.
Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura meet with their sensei.
Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura try everything they know to get through a survival test.
Naruto and his squad start their first mission with boring and menial tasks.
Naruto and his squad arrive in the Land of the Waves and learn that an evil businessman has taken over.
Kakashi has the upper hand in his battle against Zabuza.
Naruto's plan allows Kakashi to be freed from the water prison.
Recuperating, Kakashi is dissatisfied with the battle's outcome.
Sakura sees the hardships that the people of the Land of Waves endure under Gato's rule.
While Naruto concentrates on the control of his chakra, a mysterious person appears before him.
Once again, the time has come to fight Zabuza, but this time he's got company, the tracking ninja who supposedly killed him.
Naruto comes to the rescue when Sasuke finds himself in a jam inside of Haku's Crystal Ice Mirrors.
Kakashi decides to use the Sharingan once again upon perceiving his enemy's hidden strength; Haku alerts Zabuza to the strategist's maneuvers.
Naruto and Sasuke receive punishing attacks from within Haku's Crystal Ice Mirrors.
Naruto explodes and his anger against Haku unleashes the power of the Nine-tailed Fox.
Naruto questions Haku's philosophy of existing only to fight and win.
Naruto angrily confronts Zabuza, who is devastated by the loss of Haku.
Naruto and his team return to the Village Hidden in the Leaves.
Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura are chosen to take the Chunin Qualification Exam.
A ninja named Rock Lee appears and challenges Sasuke to a duel; a lightning-fast strike rapidly knocks out an interfering Naruto.
Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura register for the Chunin Exam.
Naruto and his squad begin their first exam, a written test; the interrogation specialist Ibiki invigilates, while Sasuke and Sakura fret over Naruto failing.
The hardest part of the first test in the Chunin exams arrives.

We know The Try Guys are funny, but can they handle taking the stage for their first ever live stand-up comedy set?!?

Who's fast? Who's furious? We are! Let's try drifting! We're hitting top speed around a racetrack… All. Day. Long. Who will unleash their inner Vin Diesel?! Big thanks to Drift101 driving school for letting us reach our drifting dreams!
Fire, onion volcanoes, flying eggs, Keith and Kwesi! Watch as our guys train under a pro-hibachi chef to entertain and feed a group of dinner guests.

Zombie hunting, alien sightings, drag queens, sound baths, magicians, speakeasies, and underground supper clubs!! What else would you expect in a weird and wild weekend honoring our boy Zach? This isn't just any ol' bachelor party.
Into the woods with our new tiny friends!
Who's the best at giving gifts? Keith or Zach? They each gave each other four gifts to battle it out and see who is the ultimate gift giver.
A group of guys try pretty much anything for the audience's entertainment.
Zap! Zap! Zach, Keith and Kwesi get laser hair removal on their nether regions, and it's nothing short of a hilarious, zaptastic experience.
They aren't really going to let us fly a plane, are they? OMG! Join Zach, Keith and Sequoia at Sling Pilot Academy to take to the skies, without training!
Dr. Trumpi is back, but this time she's not cracking bones, she's here to extreme deep tissue massage them; she brings Vice Grip, her deep tissue massage specialist, to help get the job done!
We give tattoos to clients without any training; watch them create works of art or maybe just work that needs to be fixed.
Zach, Eugene, Joyce and Jonny get Barbie makeovers and remake the Barbie movie trailer; watch and find out who pulls off the best Barbie look?

Zach, Kwesi, and Jared spend an entire workday with period cramp simulators attached to their bodies to see if they can better understand what people who have periods experience while on their periods.
The guys are on a mission to master beetles and bards for their Romeo + Juliet LIVE show.
It's the third and final part of our Romeo & Juliet series before the Choose Your Own Shakespeare finale; Keith, Zach and Eugene visit Swordplay LA to learn the art of stage combat.

Zach, Jonny and Jimmy are taking on the challenge of incorporating makeup into their daily routine for an entire week. Will this give them an appreciation for makeup? Will they learn how much effort goes into a makeup routine?
Kwesi and Zach try to be mermaids by attending mermaid school!
If you ever wondered what it would be like to wear dresses for an entire week, it may be common for some people; for Jonny, Zach and Jared it's a whole new world!
Watch as Keith, Zach and Kwesi blow super hard on hot glass, heat up their long poles and jam them into fiery glory holes; they learn first-hand about the craft of glassblowing!
Eugene, Zach and Keith all try their hand at going through an obstacle course sober and drunk to see how they compare; come back to see the guys try the course high!
The guys challenge themselves to visit every theme park in Southern Calif., in one day; will they be able to complete the challenge and meet all their goals?

The Try Guys Drunk Vs High is back and better than ever! Eugene, Zach and Keith all try their hand at going through an obstacle course sober and drunk to see how they compare. Come back next Wednesday to see the guys try the course high.
A group of guys try pretty much anything for the audience's entertainment.
Keith, Kwesi and Jonny work together to make Zach his own comic on Webtoon!
Zach, Keith, Ryan and Jonny take on wilderness survival training!
The Try Guys put their skills to the test to see if they can survive overnight in a temperate rainforest.
Keith, Zach, Jonny and Ryan go Truffle Hunting in Washington!
We are FINALLY trying Ghost Hunting! We go to Indiana with our friends Sam and Colby and Project Fear to get real spooky.
Keith, Zach, Kwesi and YB try to learn the art of Origami!
Our first pilot of pilot month! We hope you enjoy this brand new game show based on the age-old trolley problem. No matter what they choose, they lose.
Grant & Keith join Zach for the season premiere in an episode that, look I'll be honest here, we pushed this as far as possible right out the gate. Don't say we didn't warn you.
Rosanna Pansino and Jonny Cakes use the bathroom like dogs and ruin the spirit of Christmas.
Zach tests his friends, Marissa Rivera and Kwesi James, on their morals with hard-hitting would you rather questions.
Zach makes his friends, Kelsey and Chris, answer impossible would you rather questions to win the Best Person award!
Zach tries to cancel his friends, Miles and Jonny, with impossible would-you-rather questions.
Zach puts his friends, Keith and Joyce, through an impossible game of Would You Rather.
With some of our most consequential questions yet, Kwesi and Ash go head to head to win the Best Person Award!
Four average dudes vs. a master of chess in a battle of the wits! Can they beat Kurt Schneider at his own game?! ...oh and did we mention he'll be blindfolded?
Will she call their bluffs? Watch The Try Guys try to beat a world poker champion in the new episode of The Try Guys 4 vs. 1!
In this very special episode we're taking on a PUZZLE CHAMP in a race to the finish line!
Watch us attempt to beat a professional bowler at her own game.
Today we're teeing up with professional golfer Allison Lee to see if us 4 idiots can somehow beat a champion at her own game? Do you think anyone will be able to make a hole in one?
...Riddle me this... if you put four average people's brains together can we out puzzle the master crossword puzzler?
Warren and the others must free the Talkers being held in Quarantine and prepare to attack Altura.
The heroes break into Altura in an attempt to bring Pandora and Estes to justice; Cooper reappears, shocking Warren; there's something he has to tell her.
In Upstate New York, a zombie baby proves to be an obstacle for a diverse group of survivors, as they head cross-country in hope of creating a cure for the living-dead condition.
When the survivors run out of fuel, they embark on a dangerous mission to replenish their source; in New Jersey, Cassandra's past comes back to haunt her.
In Philadelphia, a group of psychotic outlaws confronts the survivors and a connection exists between the two parties.
Soldier zombies in Washington, D.C.; Ten Thousand's mysterious past is revealed.
The survivors search for Warren's missing husband in Central Illinois; a zombie tornado threatens the group.
A utopian enclave may not be all it seems near Branson, Mo.; the group's encounter with a religious cult may cause drastic changes.
Still reeling from the events, the survivors come across a gun show that makes the zombie apocalypse look tame.
In Nebraska, a zombie tsunami engulfs the survivors and desperate measures must be taken to survive; Citizen Z gets a visitor.
When Mack tries to have a real date with Addy, he finds himself in a nightmare that reminds him of a certain Bill Murray film with déjà vu vibes.
Radioactive zombies aren't the only danger when the survivors visit a town in South Dakota on the brink of nuclear disaster.
An all-female commune in Utah is where the two groups of survivors reunite, but when someone winds up dead, the illusion of paradise is shattered.
Murphy learns more about his abilities when he is kidnapped by a group of outlaws trying to score OxyContin; drug enhanced zombies attack.
Citizen Z redeploys the survivors to meet with Murphy's doctor; at the compound they uncover game-changing details about their mission and the origins of the zombie virus.
Everyone tries to escape the impending nuclear blast; Citizen Z battles thawed zombies and issues an air bounty for Murphy.
Heroes battle zombies and overeager bounty hunters; Murphy manages to escape; Vasquez considers working with the group.
The heroes encounter a wagon train transporting survivors of the nuclear blast to safety; they go on a quest for a cure.
While looking for a natural cure for the virus, the survivors head to the greenhouse, where Batch 47 is being grown.
A pregnant Serena tracks down Murphy; the survivors stumble across a hidden Mennonite farm with new dangers.
While Murphy is falling for his baby girl, the rest of the team is suspicious of her; Vasquez sneaks away for a meeting; 10K makes a difficult decision.
While crossing the Mississippi, the team splits up after a boating accident; 10K is drawn into a scam; Escorpion sentences 10K, Sketchy and Skeezy to death.
Murphy is captured by an unbalanced zombie fan, who is eager to add him to a zombie museum, so he must match wits to escape.
The team finds an abandoned Air Force base and discovers what looks like alien technology.
The team splits up because of a massive zombie horde and encounters a Native American tribe fighting against itself.
The team gets embroiled in corporate politics after finding a group of white collar survivors hiding out in a hotel.
The team meets La Reina, Queen of the Zeros, after being captured; Dr. Kurian is ready for human trials on his Z-vaccine at the Zero compound.
It's discovered that the Z-vaccine doesn't work; Vasquez gets caught trying to kill Escorpian; Murphy uses mental manipulation to help Warren.
Almost to the promised land in California, Addy and Mack are forced back together; the others deliver Murphy to the coordinates for the lab.

Featuring easy makeup and fashion hacks, lighthearted pranks and funny observations; entertaining and positive shows about everything trending right now.
A Mississippi woman brings her family to Los Angeles to spend Christmas with her dying mother.
Abigail makes a secret wish for Christmas, and when she does not get what she wants, she captures St. Nick.
Christmas is anything but ordinary when bickering siblings in a newly blended household magically switch bodies.
Kelly Brooks has given up on finding love during the holiday season until her childhood friend returns home for Christmas to win her heart.

Monty (Idris Elba), a mechanic, struggles to make ends meet and raise his three young daughters alone. When his drug-dealing ex-wife wins custody of the girls in court, he enlists the help of Julia (Gabrielle Union), a successful attorney, to get the girls back. Romance unexpectedly blooms between the pair, but the couple must come to terms with their very different lives and find a way to keep Monty's family together.
A woman petitions the court for a paternity test to find out if the defendant is her biological father.
Madea gets herself into outrageous situations while helping children save their youth center.

After civil engineer Arlo Pear (Richard Pryor) loses his job following a corporate merger, he must sell his house and move with his wife, Monica (Beverly Todd), and daughter, Casey (Stacey Dash), 2,000 miles from small-town New Jersey to Boise, Idaho. Unfortunately, the moving company -- led by slippery, fast-talking Perry (Robert LaSardo) -- has other ideas. When the movers go AWOL with the Pear family's belongings in the midst of the journey, Pear decides to take matters into his own hands.

Clyde Shelton is an honorable family man, until the day his wife and daughter are murdered in a home invasion. He hopes for justice, but a rising prosecutor named Nick Rice cuts a deal with one of the killers in exchange for testimony. Ten years later, that man is found dead.
Career-driven investment banker Elle has given up on love until she meets Wesley, who invites her to his hometown in South Carolina, where she rediscovers the spirit of Christmas.
To appease her family during the holidays, a single woman (Malinda Williams) pretends to be engaged to her employee (Brad James).

Marci throws herself into preparing for Christmas and building her new event-planning business. But when the business gets off to a rocky start and members of her family face their own hardships, Marci steps up to help everyone have a good holiday.
A little girl's plans for a perfect Christmas go off the rails when her dad leaves on business and her dog runs away.
Fun DIY-projects, crafts, experience the joy of doing it yourself!

Tris Prior lives in a futuristic world in which society is divided into five factions. As each person enters adulthood, he or she must choose a faction and commit to it for life. Tris chooses Dauntless -- those who pursue bravery above all else. However, her initiation leads to the discovery that she is a Divergent and will never be able to fit into just one faction. Warned that she must conceal her status, Tris uncovers a looming war which threatens everyone she loves.

Now on the run from Jeanine and the rest of the power-hungry Erudites, Tris and Four search for allies and answers in the ruins of Chicago. They must find out what Tris' family sacrificed their lives to protect and why the Erudites will do anything to stop them. Side by side, Tris and Four face one seemingly insurmountable challenge after another, as they unravel the secrets of the past and -- ultimately -- the future of their world.

Tris escapes with Four to journey beyond the wall that encloses Chicago. For the first time, they leave the only city and family they have ever known to find a peaceful solution. Once outside, they learn shocking new truths that render old discoveries meaningless. As the ruthless battle threatens humanity, Tris and Four quickly decide who to trust to survive. Tris must ultimately make difficult choices about courage, allegiance, sacrifice and love.

Caius Martius, aka Coriolanus (Ralph Fiennes), is an arrogant and fearsome general who has built a career on protecting Rome from its enemies. Pushed by his ambitious mother (Vanessa Redgrave) to seek the position of consul, Coriolanus is at odds with the masses and unpopular with certain colleagues (James Nesbitt, Paul Jesson). When a riot results in his expulsion from Rome, Coriolanus seeks out his sworn enemy, Tullus Aufidius (Gerard Butler). Together, the pair vow to destroy the great city.
Held hostage by a dangerous couple, a widower and his daughter must work together to outsmart their captors and survive the night.

A logger and his father head to their hunting cabin, hoping for a quiet weekend. Instead, they find themselves in a kill-or-be-killed stand for survival when they encounter a gang of ruthless drug traffickers.

After a wild one-night stand, a successful sports agent watches his perfect life slowly disappear when he discovers the sexy and mysterious woman he risked everything for is a determined police detective who entangles him in her latest investigation. As he desperately tries to put the pieces together, he falls deeper into her trap, risking his family, his career, and even his life.

As a young cop, Erin Bell went undercover to infiltrate a gang in the California desert -- with tragic results. Bell continues to work as a detective for the Los Angeles Police Department, but feelings of anger and remorse leave her worn-down and consumed by guilt. When the leader of that gang suddenly re-emerges, Erin embarks on an obsessive quest to find his former associates, bring him to justice and make peace with her tortured past.

A drug operation changes the lives of three conflicted New York cops. Burned-out vet Eddie Dugan is close to retirement; narcotics cop Sal Procida faces the difficult task of caring for his large family on his ordinary salary. Undercover officer Clarence Tango Butler finds his loyalties beginning to shift toward a powerful drug dealer. Over seven chaotic days, the three men are drawn toward a fateful crime and destiny.

At 18 years old, Jason receives a mandatory 10-year prison sentence after being caught with a package that contained illegal drugs, although he was unaware of its contents. His father, businessman John Matthews (Dwayne Johnson), is devastated. When Jason turns down a chance to lessen his sentence by manufacturing evidence to implicate someone else, John begs to be sent undercover instead, but the already dangerous venture turns deadly after he exposes a major player in the Mexican drug trade.

Assailed by nightmarish visions, Alex Whitaker (Paul Le Mat) and his fellow psychics descend on the Bodega Bay Inn. There, they discover that their compatriot Neil (Jimmie F. Scaggs) has apparently committed suicide. But, as the gruesome visions continue, they sense that there's still something sinister afoot. When they find themselves hunted by a band of homicidal marionettes created by twisted puppeteer Andre Toulon (William Hickey), they discover they're right.

Hunter's (Brian Gallagher) life turns upside down after his daughter is killed by a drunken driver. He disappears into the woods, and no one sees him for years -- until several partying teenagers are brutally killed one by one.

Two couples, each working through relationship issues, rent a gorgeous house in the desert for a sex- and drug-fueled escape from reality. As tensions escalate throughout a debaucherous night, things take an unexpected turn when a woman claiming to be a neighbor with car trouble shows up at the door. She seems harmless enough, or so they think.

Deep in the woods of Northern California lies the off-the-grid town of Willits, a haven for marijuana growers, meth addicts and conspiracy theorists. When a gaggle of vacationing teens unknowingly set up their campsite on the property of Willits' most disturbed resident, a psychotic, drug-addled pot farmer who is convinced that extraterrestrials are out to get him, they're in for one hell of a bad time.

In the Old West, a sheriff (Kurt Russell), his deputy (Richard Jenkins), a gunslinger (Matthew Fox), and a cowboy (Patrick Wilson) embark on a mission to rescue three people from a savage group of cave dwellers.
Seth sees his best friend disappear in a flash of light. Two years later, Seth is still dealing with the fallout and suspicions when a series of grisly murders rocks the community.
A serial killer brings an unsuspecting new victim on a weekend getaway to add another body to his ever-growing count. She's buying into his faux charms, and he's eagerly lusting for blood.
A man sells a nefarious-looking puppet at a small-town convention for some quick cash. Terror soon strikes when an ancient evil animates the other puppets and sends them on a bloody killing spree.
Wherever your destination, traveling local or far, indoor or outdoor, you can be sure AccuWeather Weekend always has you covered.
Goes beyond the forecast to give you the how and why about stuff you wanted to ask about weather, space and science.
An art student (Pierre Brice) in 1912 Holland finds posed statues are petrified corpses drained by a madman (Wolfgang Preiss).

Selfish teen Alex Gardner (Dennis Quaid) is coerced into joining a government project in which psychics like him are trained to enter others' dreams. He starts learning to use his abilities to do good, but before long, a new official, Bob Blair (Christopher Plummer), seizes control of the project. A writer (George Wendt) helps Alex uncover Blair's true motives, which involve assassination via dreams. Soon, only Alex and a beautiful scientist (Kate Capshaw) stand in the way of something terrible.

Decades after the abduction of his newborn twin, world-famous American pianist John Ma (Jackie Chan) arrives in Hong Kong to perform and finds himself face-to-face with Boomer (Jackie Chan), the identical twin brother he has never known. When the reunited brothers switch places by mistake, John discovers that Boomer is a petty criminal with a knack for getting into trouble. Soon John gets in over his head with a group of gangsters looking for Boomer, and his brother vows to save him.
An ex-military man strives for a secret life of crime, and his path leads to the kidnapping of a teenage heiress.
Boozing charter pilots (Terence Hill, Bud Spencer) in the Andes help out emerald hunters on the Amazon.

After the parents of Ruby (Leelee Sobieski) and her younger brother, Rhett (Trevor Morgan), are killed in a car crash, their parents' best friends, Erin and Terry Glass (Diane Lane, Stellan Skarsgard), become their guardians. The children hear promises of a world of opulence and California fun -- all they have to do is move into the Glasses' gated house. Before very long, though, Ruby suspects that Erin and Terry may not be the ideal guardians they seemed to be.
To finally achieve victory over a rival kingdom, a brilliant general devises an intricate plan involving his wife, a look-alike and two kings.

Things take an unexpected turn when an independent career woman who dreams of having a family meets a man who has no plans of getting married.

A railroad worker and his ragtag group of freedom fighters find themselves on the wrong side of the tracks when they decide to ambush a heavily armed military train filled with desperately needed provisions. Unarmed and outnumbered, they must rely on their wits to battle an entire army.

Suzanne is tired of being the bad cop and Nick being the good cop with the kids, so they decide to switch places.

When Nick happens upon an old college pal, the unexpected meeting gives rise to a business plan that involves a sports star and an energy drink. The results, however, are not so bubbly.
Suzanne and Nick go out with another couple, her friend Danielle and husband Steve. However, the double date soon fizzles when an accusation flies.
Nick is forced to get an assistant, who is a must-hire from his boss. But when the assistant gets too close to his family and friends, Nick is forced to take action.
Nick helps out Willie Mays, a homeless man with a beautiful voice, by getting him a job at KAWT, but Willie takes advantage of his new job.
After a website votes Nick Sexiest Seattle Sportscaster, he tries to embrace his new image. But Nick soon learns being a sex symbol isn't all it's cracked up to be.
Romantic complications ensue when Nick helps a shy colleague improve his love life. Meanwhile, a pinkeye epidemic keeps Lindsey away from school.
Suzanne suspects that Lindsey's athletic new crush from school is gay. However, Nick sets out to prove that he is not in order to save Lindsey from disappointment.
Lindsey and Kevin enter Nick into a Hand on a House contest, where finalists compete by seeing who can keep their hand on a house for the longest.
When Nick inadvertently insults Harold Bradley (a KAWT employee who has been around forever) on-air, he is forced to do damage control.
When a new buxom woman gets hired at the station, Nick's career is threatened. Suzanne takes matters into her own hands to save her husband's job.
Nick and Suzanne consider purchasing life insurance as they feel it would be a good decision to protect their family. However, Nick has reservations about buying a policy.
After a Guys' Night Out, Nick and his friends struggle to recollect the events that led to the disappearance of his wedding ring - and Kevin.
After Kevin watches 'The Sixth Sense', he starts having nightmares that disrupt Nick and Suzanne's sleep.

When Suzanne wants a real honeymoon, Nick tries to plan an extravagant surprise, but despite his best efforts to create something romantic, instead misleads Suzanne into thinking he is cheating on her.
When Nick gets a doctors report that he has high blood pressure, Suzanne does everything she can to make sure his stress levels stay low.
Nick struggles to prove himself when he is promoted to co-host alongside the lazy, arrogant Brick Street.
When Suzanne gets roped into a committee at Kevin's school, where the other mums are mean to her, Nick volunteers to fill in on her behalf, making things awkward when the ladies love him.

Nick goes to watch a game with friends at a sports bar known to have sexy female waitresses. The kids want a larger allowance, but they are not willing to do more chores in return for a higher payout.
Annoyed that she and Nick never do anything together as a couple, Suzanne signs the two of them up for salsa lessons, but is surprised by her control issues on the dance floor.
Using her mother's credit card, Lindsey gets help from Nick in ordering a Michelle Obama jumper online. Kevin pretends to be sick to pull off a scam to get a signed A-Rod jersey.
Lindsey makes a reality show about her family, but she thinks they are too boring - until Kevin finds Suzanne's gun in her bedroom and shows it to Troy, bringing real danger to the household.

Everyone tries to resolve personal issues while stuck in line the morning of a Black Friday sale. Kevin anticipates buying a new video game, Lindsey meets a boy, relationship problems plague Martin and Terrence hopes to buy toys for charity.
Nick becomes a more influential parent, so he pushes Kevin and Lindsey hard, and they become model children.
Nick hesitantly attends his high school reunion, but all of his fears come true when his high school nickname haunts him throughout the event. Lindsey prepares a feast.
When Nick realises he is the same age his father was when he died, he decides not to waste another minute and starts tackling a list of risky activities to accomplish before he dies.
While hosting an awards ceremony, Nick gets laughs by making Suzanne the butt of his jokes, but finds he cannot stand the heat when Suzanne turns the tables and starts making fun of him in public.
When the family oversleeps on the morning Lindsey is set to sing the National Anthem at a baseball game, it is all hands on deck just to make it to out of the house on time.
When Suzanne's Mother comes to visit, she attacks Nick for being an inadequate husband, while hiding her true feelings of her own husband's inadequacy, until Suzanne and Terrence press her.

Nick attempts to make a profit off an expensive set of African masks that Kevin bought at a yard sale, but instead, he becomes the victim of a larger scam. Lindsey receives advice about her upcoming date with her crush.
When Nick messes up Suzanne's plans for spring break, he turns the house into a makeshift resort, and promises to give the family the best holiday ever.
When Suzanne crashes a night with Nick and his boys, Nick decides he needs to pay her back by showing up for spa treatments with Suzanne and her girlfriends to show her what it is like.
Nick decides the kids need to bond with his mother and asks that they spend time together. Suzanne has a day off, but she does not know what to do, now that she has a lot of time on her hands.
When the entire Kingston-Persons's clan plus guests end up at the house for a pot-luck Thanksgiving, Suzanne has to scramble to find the one item she was in charge of - the turkey.
Lindsey gets high when her friend gives her a drug and learns a hard lesson.
Yi Jung's mother frantically calls him threatening to commit suicide.
A note indicates that class has been moved to the science lab. The lab is unoccupied, but Jan Di waits, not realizing that the room is filling with fumes.
Jan Di's father gets kidnapped by loan sharks, which inevitably forces Jan Di's mother to swallow her pride and plead for Madam Kang's help.
The F4 guys have moved on to college while Jan Di has entered her senior year of high school. She has not heard from Jun Pyo since he left.
Jan Di waits to hear the conclusions of F3's meeting with Jun-pyo, and can tell from their look that it was not good.
After treating Jan Di in a cruel manner, Mr. Jung prepares everything so that Jun-Pyo can visit her in Seoul. Will he be able to go without Madam Kang finding out?
Jan Di's family hears about Jun-pyo's engagement and asks her miserably if it's true.
Ji-hoo can see how hurt Jan Di is by the kiss, and continues to follow her as she stumbles around in shock.
Jun-pyo begins seeing Jae-Kyung in a new light, like he's seeing her for the first time as a potential friend -- or maybe a kindred spirit.
Aoi and Hazuka are classmates, but they are not friends. The two girls meet an elderly woman who wants to give a love letter to her first love. Hazuka and Aoi try to find her first love.
Woo-bin tries to talk some sense into Yi-jung, who is determined to drink himself into a stupor.
At home, Jun-hee reminisces about how her mother meddled in her life, in much the same way she's interfering in Jun-pyo's now.
Yi-jung is waiting outside for Eun-jae, excited to see her -- until he listens in on her phone conversation; from her words, it sounds like a call to a boyfriend.
Jun-pyo begs for Jan Di to advise him not to get married.
Jun-pyo tells Jan Di that he'll protect her, but to Jun-pyo's surprise, she says that she does not want to be cosseted or taken care of.
Perhaps feeling it's time to expose one truth, Mr. Jung leads Jun-hee to the unknown patient's bedside; at the sight of her father, Jun-hee breaks down.
Jun-pyo asks Yumi to make the lunchbox once more, confirming that Yumi had taken credit for her lunch.
Just being rich isn't enough to endure the teen oppression at Shinhwa -- loners are often marked as targets by the bored über-clique called F4.
A wicked rumor is spread on the Internet that a second-year student at Shinhwa High School is pregnant.

Victoria Grant (Julie Andrews), a down-and-out British soprano, struggles to find work in the nightclubs of 1930s Paris. While trying to scam a free meal, Grant meets cabaret performer Toddy (Robert Preston), who comes up with an idea that will change everything. Acting as her manager, Toddy bills Grant as a male female impersonator. When the nightclubs eat it up, the duo makes it big -- even a Chicago mobster (James Garner) is enamored with Grant. But keeping the truth a secret is no easy task.

Roy (Nicolas Cage), a depressed con artist with obsessive-compulsive disorder, and Frank (Sam Rockwell), his partner, find their line of work complicated by the arrival of Roy's teenage daughter, Angela (Alison Lohman). Angela brings some spirit back into Roy's life, and some of his disorder symptoms seem to disappear. But when Angela wants to learn the family business, and Roy allows her to assist on a big scam concerning a businessmen (Bruce McGill), he reconsiders his parenting techniques.

When psychologist Norman Goodman (Dustin Hoffman) wrote a report for the government on how to deal with extraterrestrial life forces, he didn't expect his recommendations to be used. Now that a secret government agency is investigating what may be an alien spaceship that has been discovered partially buried on the floor of the Pacific Ocean, Norman finds that the plan he outlined is being put into effect and that the team he named in his report has been assembled.

College student Wyatt (Paul Rudd) is convinced that his hometown girlfriend, Kimberly (Christine Taylor), is cheating on him. Disconsolate at a strip club, he nonetheless tries to defend the honor of Ivy (Reese Witherspoon), one of the dancers, who befriends him for his gesture. Ivy convinces Wyatt that he should send Kimberly a vicious breakup letter, which he does, by express mail. When he has second thoughts, he and Ivy hit the road to retrieve the note before it reaches its destination.

New York Times reporter Sydney Schanberg (Sam Waterston) is on assignment covering the Cambodian Civil War, with the help of local interpreter Dith Pran (Haing S. Ngor) and American photojournalist Al Rockoff (John Malkovich). When the U.S. Army pulls out amid escalating violence, Schanberg makes exit arrangements for Pran and his family. Pran, however, tells Schanberg he intends to stay in Cambodia to help cover the unfolding story -- a decision he may regret as the Khmer Rouge rebels move in.

Power-hungry Queen Gedren (Sandahl Bergman) captures the priestesses guarding the Talisman, a mystical orb that created and can destroy the world. But one of the priestesses escapes and seeks out her warrior sister, Red Sonja (Brigitte Nielsen), to warn her about Gedren's plan for world domination. Lord Kalidor (Arnold Schwarzenegger), the Talisman's keeper, insists on helping Sonja, and though she scorns the assistance of any man, she soon gains respect for Kalidor's fighting prowess.

Gardner Barnes is a young Texan who has just graduated from college and is unsure of what to do next. Along with his friends, collectively known as the Groovers, Gardner embarks on a road trip to the Rio Grande as a last hurrah for the group. As the trip progresses, Gardner and his buddies, including Kenneth Waggener and Phil Hicks, struggle with their impending adulthood and the looming issue of the Vietnam War.

Mystery novelist Phil Blackwood has written countless bestsellers, but he's having trouble finding inspiration for his latest book, so he goes to the courthouse to observe real criminals in action. There he encounters Nina, a gorgeous immigrant charged with a gruesome murder. Convinced she's not guilty, Phil furnishes Nina with an alibi and a place to stay. But, as the two begin to fall in love, Phil finds he has grave doubts about her innocence.
Arthur's (Dudley Moore) wife (Liza Minnelli) goes back to work when the tippling Park Avenue heir loses his money and hits Skid Row.

This adaptation of the non-fiction novel by Tom Wolfe chronicles the first 15 years of America's space program. By focusing on the lives of the Mercury astronauts, including John Glenn (Ed Harris) and Alan Shepard (Scott Glenn), the film recounts the dangers and frustrations experienced by those involved with NASA's earliest achievements. It also depicts their family lives and the personal crises they endured during an era of great political turmoil and technological innovation.

For years, screenwriting team Richard Babson (Burt Reynolds) and Paula McCullen (Goldie Hawn) have built a successful Hollywood career while managing to live harmoniously together. After finishing their latest script, Babson uses the euphoria to convince McCullen to take the leap into marriage. However, when the newlywed couple travels back east to meet their respective in-laws, the pitfalls of marriage begin to surface. Unprepared, Babson and McCullen struggle with the changing dynamics.

Although they are each engaged to other people, former athlete Mike Gambril and vocalist Terry McKay fall for each other on an international flight that gets diverted due to technical problems. After their trip, they agree to meet in New York City three months later, but tragedy strikes on the day of their reunion, resulting in Terry's hospitalization, which is unknown to Mike. Can the star-crossed lovers finally find each other?

Esta serie dramática representa en cada capítulo de una hora historias distintas y reales sobre mujeres mexicanas que atraviesan diferentes vicisitudes. Las experiencias de estas mujeres tratan de temas censurados por la sociedad y por lo tanto ellas los enfrentan en silencio, algunas de las situaciones que se examinan son: el abuso infantil, el embarazo no deseado, asesinatos, la pornografía y la violencia familiar entre otras. Al final de cada episodio se muestra una lista de centros o agencias de ayuda para personas que se sientan identificadas con los casos específicos, se hace un llamado para que busquen ayuda y rompan su silencio.
Un espacio en el que se tocan temas controversiales, de forma abierta y sin censura como sexo, infidelidad, identidad de género, salud mental, conductas delictivas, o fractura familiar.

At the end of each episode, viewers are told which stories were made up and which were real. Jack Conrad es un reo condenado a la pena de muerte que espera su ejecución en una cárcel centroamericana, pero un productor de televisión lo compra y lo lleva a una isla remota. Ahí Jack y otros nueve prisioneros descubren que deben luchar entre ellos hasta la muerte, y el premio es la libertad para el único sobreviviente. El productor planea transmitir el evento en vivo y sin censura por la Internet.

Un cazarrecompensas tendrá que luchar al límite para escapar de un juego en el que los convictos son obligados a enfrentarse a vida o muerte mientras se transmite lo que ocurre a una audiencia ávida de sangre.
Una viuda anciana tiene una relación especial con un criminal y su hija después de que ellos se convierten en sus inquilinos.
Los Dover se encuentran en medio de un problema financiero y recurren a los padres de Dan en busca de ayuda.

Ann, una estrella de la televisión, abandona Hollywood y termina en el territorio de los amish, donde encuentra amistad, amor y, finalmente, una identidad auténtica. Ann tendrá que decidir entre su nuevo estilo de vida y el antiguo.

Kennedy Blaine visita un rancho que ha heredado en la pequeña localidad de Valentine. Cuando conoce al capataz del rancho, Derek, él la convence para que se quede y conozca los beneficios de una vida más pacífica.
Un jinete de toros herido, cuya carrera en el rodeo está a punto de terminar, acepta robar caballos para un prestamista implacable.

Unos pilotos jóvenes e inexpertos de las Fuerzas Aéreas estadounidenses protegen un arma biológica de los militares rusos, quienes están dispuestos a acabar con quien se interponga en su camino por conseguirla.

Un veterano de guerra ayuda a un adolescente y a su hermano de 10 años a salir de la MS-13, la pandilla más peligrosa de las calles de Washington D.C. Sin embargo, el jefe de la pandilla da a los chicos dos opciones: ser pandilleros o morir.

Paula Duarte y Alejandro Monroy son una pareja de jóvenes que deben separarse porque Alejandro se va a estudiar al exterior. Ambos vuelven a hacer sus vidas, se casan y tienen hijos pero jamás logran olvidar al otro. Tiempo después, la vida planea un reencuentro cuando Tania, la hija de Paula, y Eduardo, el hijo de Alejandro, se hacen novios. El volverse a ver avivará la chispa de la pasión que alguna vez estuvo encendida. Sin embargo, este amor se enfrentará a muchas dificultades, comenzado por la relación que existe entre sus hijos y que no puedan aceptar el amor entre sus padres.

Fatmagül es una joven huérfana que vive en un humilde pueblo y sueña con una mejor vida junto a su gran amor Mustafá, quien está construyendo la casa donde vivirán cuando se casen. Sin embargo, el destino le depara una sorpresa que cambiará su vida.
La historia jamás contada de los hermanos Castaño: Fidel, Carlos y Vicente, tres hombres que convulsionaron la historia reciente de Colombia. Una familia unida por la tragedia y la venganza.
Antonio Puentes llega a Vidisterra para casarse con su novia, Angie, quien nació y se crio entre los viñedos del pueblo.

Un hombre rico muere y deja a su viuda y tres hijos en una excelente posición. Ellos entran a la alta sociedad, tienen mucho dinero y la vida parece que les sonríe, pero pronto los problemas se presentan.
Ricardo ordena que secuestren a Julián y también se llevan a Cicatriz vestida de Irina. Mariana colabora con la policía para encontrar más pruebas contra el asesino de Camila.
