Cicatriz logra escapar y llega a casa de Ricardo con la intención de asesinarlo y vengar la muerte de su padre. Micaela vuelve a los malos pasos y le roba dinero a una clienta de la peluquería.

Federico despierta y se da cuenta de que está esposado, Sofía le asegura que le conseguirá un buen abogado. Rogelio intenta matar a Domingo, pero falla y mata a Lola. Sofía le pide a Domingo que le consiga un arma.

La historia del capitán Carlos Camacho Espíritu, un inmigrante que halló el éxito al dejar su país para convertirse en uno de los primeros locutores de radio en tocar la música regional mexicana en una estación radial de Los Ángeles en EE.UU.
Fidel miente a su familia sobre la muerte de Romualda, pero Carlos duda de su versión. La guerrilla asesina a Fidel en una emboscada. Góngora pide borrar sus conversaciones con los Castaños.
Salvador confiesa que mató a Fidel Castaño. Carlos enfrenta una dura revelación personal y se convierte en el nuevo comandante de las autodefensas. Luciano regresa y busca a Karen.
Carlos se sacrifica para ayudar a Luciano y culpa a Salvador por hablar. El coronel Badillo entrega a Salvador a las autodefensas. Karen preocupada porque cree que algo malo le pasó a Luciano.
Alicia y Manuel se refugian, creen que lo mejor que pueden hacer es quitarle el dinero a Sandoval y entregar a todos los narcos. Richard acepta colaborar con la D4 para atrapar a Alicia.

La seductora agente secreto Helena regresa para cumplir una nueva misión: debe infiltrarse en el círculo privado de un científico genial, de quien sospechan que ha desarrollado un virus altamente mortal y contagioso.
Una manera más relajada de comenzar el día.

Ricardo Soto está casado con Miranda Robles, una mujer guapa con una afortunada posición social. Su esposo aprovechará esta situación para ponerle el cuerno con una jovencita mucho menor que él, sin recordar que el que ríe al último, ríe mejor.
Un empleado del gobierno quiere alejarse de la corrupción, pero se ve atrapado entre perderlo todo o unirse al juego.
Elena es una escurridiza ladrona y artista del disfraz. Al verse perseguida por la policía, se disfraza de monja y se refugia en un convento, donde seguirá cometiendo imprudencias.

Jackie es una joven que disfruta de ayudar a los más necesitados, pero su esposo Samuel no comparte este sentimiento. Un trágico accidente lo deja en coma y entonces ella decide seguir su vida y volverse a enamorar.

Dos jóvenes se reencuentran en otra vida. Alejandro reconoce a Yolanda, quien pertenece a una extraña familia y a la que él culpa de la muerte de su padre. Alejandro busca el secreto detrás de la muerte de su padre.
Años después de sufrir un trágico accidente, una atleta de patinaje artístico acepta entrenar a una joven estudiante.
Después de heredar la mitad del viñedo de su tío, una mujer debe trabajar con el copropietario durante tres semanas o arriesgarse a perder la tierra.
Cuando su agencia de publicidad es absorbida por una empresa mucho más grande y más poderosa, la rivalidad de Darby con su nuevo compañero Derrick podría convertirse en algo más.

Una empresaria de tecnología se sorprende al saber que el taller de reparación de vehículos de su padre tiene problemas financieros. Pronto se entera de que una encantadora amiga de la infancia quiere comprar el negocio.
La vida amorosa de una personalidad de la radio y experto en relaciones es un caos; pero cuando empieza a seguir sus propios consejos, todo cambia.
Un niño blanco (Zak Ludwig) y un compañero moreno (Jaishon Fisher) se hacen amigos cuando su padre (Billy Ray Cyrus) y la abuela (Candus Churchill) los obligan a pasar un tiempo juntos.
Una joven mujer y su indiferente padre deben trabajar juntos para salvar el rancho de ganado de su abuelo fallecido.
Un niño que acaba de quedar huérfano entabla una inusual amistad con un recluso mientras vive con sus tíos.
El hijo de Santa se une con desagrado al negocio familiar, pero debe limpiar su nombre tras ser arrestado por robo.
Después de la muerte de su padre, una ex-estrella del fútbol americano se reúne con la familia que abandonó años atrás.
Un hombre se entera de que la carta de amor de secundaria que escribió a su mejor amiga, está ahora en las manos de su nuevo novio.
Santa regresa para ayudar a una nueva pareja a encontrar el misterio y el romance. El festival navideño de un pueblo se ve amenazado así que Dalton y Zoey unen fuerzas para encontrar al culpable.
Una jueza (Jaclyn Smith) severa acepta la custodia temporal de una adolescente (Lyndsy Fonseca) problemática que ha vivido con varias familias adoptivas.
La sobrina de una viuda se embarca en un viaje peligroso para encontrar a su hermano desaparecido.
Surgen los problemas cuando una pareja de viudos y sus hijos se juntan a festejar la Navidad.
Un hombre cuyo aspecto le es familiar puede ser la respuesta a un antiguo deseo navideño de una mujer de 33 años.

Carla viaja a la misteriosa ciudad de Pyramiden, la ciudad más al norte del mundo, para crear una empresa de turismo extremo. Sergei, un guardia local, intentará por todos los medios impedir que lo consiga.
Clara decide contraer matrimonio, pero es salvajemente asesinada, al igual que decenas de víctimas. Nadie tiene una explicación de los sucesos.

El dueño de una enorme casa de campo, situada en el pueblo de Barrancas, tiene fama de pagar mal a sus empleados; por lo que cuando el cuidador de la casa no aparece, todos piensan que se fue. Mario, el sobrino del dueño, es enviado de imprevisto a pagar los servicios y entregar la casa a un nuevo cuidador. Mario se aprovecha de la situación para invitar, sin permiso, a la chica que le gusta y a algunos amigos de la universidad. Lo que Mario no sabe, es el peligro que corre.
Un experimentado detective pierde a su familia en un accidente. Es un hombre solitario y se encuentra investigando una serie de crímenes.

Clara trabajaba como asistente de Norman, un escritor. Diez años después, las personas más cercanas de Clara empiezan a morir, una tras otra. Clara está segura de que Norman es el culpable de todo, pero, ¿cómo demostrarlo?
Toco, un viejo montañés, viaja con su trineo y se encuentra con un hombre tirado a la vera del camino. Lo lleva a su casa, y cuando este recupera su conciencia, se deslumbra con los trineos.

Después de una larga búsqueda, las autoridades atrapan al supuesto "asesino de Malagua", un individuo al cual se le acusa de asesinar cruelmente a más de veinte víctimas. Tras las rejas, es visitado por un reportero debido a los fuertes rumores de que él es la persona equivocada, por lo que cuenta la verdad de lo que realmente pasó.

A group of young Muslim men living in Sheffield decide to wage jihad, and they hatch an inept plan to become suicide bombers. Omar (Riz Ahmed) and Waj (Kayvan Novak) have a brief, disastrous run at a Pakistan training camp, while Faisal (Adeel Akhtar) works on an unlikely scheme to train birds to carry bombs. Their ill-conceived plan culminates at the London Marathon with their bumbling attempts to disrupt the event while dressed in outlandish costumes.

A retired hairdresser escapes his nursing home and embarks on an odyssey across his small town to style a dead woman's hair for her funeral, confronting the ghosts of his past and rediscovering his sparkle along the way.
A mysterious individual known as "The Sommelier" leads a group of friends on a raucous road trip through wine country.
When an oddball mailroom worker finds out that his boss's son is being bullied, he forms a ragtag team of would-be mercenaries to protect the boy.

Lisa is the general manager of Double Whammies, a sports bar that features skimpily dressed waitresses. Always nurturing and protective of her staff, she soon faces one trying day that tests her optimism at every turn.

Defying his father and dropping out of law school, aspiring writer Troy Gable looks for a way to gain some meaningful life experience. Troy gets that and more when he takes a job with Buck Howard, a vainglorious mentalist who hopes to reinvigorate his fading career by staging a big comeback.

Aurelie, 13, dreams about getting a perm so that she can finally fit in at her small-town Virginia school. Things soon go incredibly wrong when her clueless parents bring her to a beauty school to save a few bucks.
En route to Canada with stolen casino loot, a thief (Olivia Wilde) separates from her brother (Eric Bana) and falls in with a boxer (Charlie Hunnam) who's on his way home for Thanksgiving.

Conned into buying a shady '65 Chrysler, shy teen Mike's eagerly anticipated first date with the girl next door, Kelsey, implodes as he finds himself targeted by criminals, cops and a crazy cat lady. A night fueled by desire, bullets and burning rubber makes any other first date seem like a walk in the park.
Tyler spirals out of control when he realizes he's the only black person attending a weekend birthday party in a secluded cabin.
A substitute teacher's crushing discontent drives her to an ill-advised transgression.

During the course of an ordinary week in Hollywood, movie producer Ben must navigate his way through shark-infested waters as he struggles to complete his latest projects. A demanding studio boss demands extensive changes to a movie starring Sean Penn, while another chief won't greenlight a project unless star Bruce Willis shaves his beard. Meanwhile, Ben tries to reconcile with his wife and maintain a relationship with his young daughter.
A young woman (Michelle Williams) is torn between the husband (Seth Rogen) that she loves and a new man (Luke Kirby) in her life, whom she's unable to ignore.
A man works for a company called Infinity Baby, which is tasked with farming out 3-month-old babies who don't age.
An alcoholic, disabled novelist finds his muse again after he moves into a lakeside cabin and meets a single mother and her daughters.

Peter (John Hargreaves) and Marcia (Briony Behets), a bitter married couple teetering on the edge of divorce, take a camping trip to heal the rift between them. When Peter and Marcia become the targets of a series of inexplicable animal attacks, it becomes clear that an angry Mother Nature has come to exact her revenge.

John "Breacher" Wharton (Arnold Schwarzenegger) leads an elite DEA task force. Its latest mission is a high-stakes raid on a safe house owned by one of the world's deadliest drug cartels. All hell breaks loose for the officers when they run afoul of a vicious Mexican cartel.

Monty Don has advice on how to successfully store an apple crop so it will last through winter and explains why he thinks it high time wall flowers came back into fashion. Meanwhile, Carol is home at Glebe Cottage, dividing her perennials to continue the cost-effective stocking of her new beds.

Monty Don tackles some seasonal gardening jobs at Longmeadow and guest presenter Matthew Wilson has some ideas to brighten up a dark, north-facing wall.

Monty propagates succulent plants, revisits his container vegetable garden, and gives advice on how to get a good crop of pumpkins. Adam looks a new garden at RHS Hyde Hall in Essex, and Rachel visits a garden of vibrant colours in Wiltshire.
As autumn unfolds in the garden, Monty Don and Nigel make the most of the season and prepare for the winter ahead. Meanwhile, Carol Klein is in Surrey looking at wild and cultivated heathers.

As autumn unfolds in the garden, Monty Don has plenty to be getting on with at Longmeadow. In his quest to track down some of the nation's most remarkable allotments, Joe Swift visits a tropical paradise in Runcorn.

The team celebrate the bounty our gardens have to offer at this time of year as Carol Klein gathers wild blackberries, Monty Don is at Longmeadow, and we join a champion vegetable grower in Yorkshire as he prepares for the biggest show of the season.
Monty and the team celebrate the wonder of trees and explore the vital role they play in gardens and the wider landscape. Zoe Ball joins Toby Buckland on a visit to a tree project in North London.

Monty has tips and ideas for planting up garden pots to provide a focal point over the winter months, Rachel visits the tulips of Keukenhof, Joe visits Esther Rantzen's much-loved garden, and Carol visits Glebe Cottage.

Monty shows how to take cuttings from herbs, prune summer raspberries and plant daylilies. Meanwhile, Adam travels to Whitstable on the Kent coast to see how gardeners cope with the wild, wet and windy weather.
As the plants in the jewel garden reach the peak of their late summer glory, Monty starts planning for the spring when he plants ferns and gives advice on the care and maintenance of wildlife ponds.

At Longmeadow, Monty is planning for next summer by sowing a batch of sweet peas. Meanwhile, Carol Klein is amongst the leaves, bark and berries at Thorp Perrow Arboretum in Yorkshire admiring the onset of the autumn display. Plus, there's a visit to Ryton Gardens in Warwickshire to find out about their collection of heritage vegetables and how to collect their seeds.

As autumn gathers momentum, it's time to start putting the garden to bed for winter. Monty Don has some timely advice on what to do. Carol Klein meets a nurseryman in Herefordshire, and together they indulge in the beauty of the Japanese maple.

Monty revels in the roses in his garden, harvests honey from his bees and gives advice on the maintenance of hardy geraniums as well as planting others for summer ground cover. Rachel de Thame shows how the most ordinary of spaces can be transformed by adding seasonal containers.

Monty plants for pollinators in the Wildlife Garden and trims his box topiary cones. He also takes succulent leaf cuttings and continues the summer veg harvest. Meanwhile, Carol Klein visits stunning Italian-influenced gardens in Gloucestershire.

Monty is preparing for spring colour as well as harvesting pumpkins and squashes. Carol Klein visits comedian Joe Lycett at home, and together, they plant up a container packed with layers of colourful bulbs. Toby Buckland visits Sue Kent's garden near Swansea to help out with autumnal maintenance.

In the second of her films about botany, Carol Klein goes underground to unravel the mysteries of roots and why they are so important to the health of our plants. Joe Swift meets fashion icon, Dame Zandra Rhodes, to explore how the flowers she likes to grow have influenced her designs over the years.
Monty continues with his revamp of the Cottage Garden by planting bare-root roses. Meanwhile, Adam Frost visits a challenging garden built on an exposed slope in the Lake District.

Monty Don gets going with some autumn garden maintenance whilst looking back over the year and reviewing his borders - which plants have done well and others that haven't. As he clears annuals that are past their best he plans a colourful display for late spring by planting up the garden with tulips. Carol Klein is at Glebe Cottage continuing work on her new raised beds and taming an overgrown and unruly rambling rose.
Daily talk show hosted by Geraldo Rivera and featuring on-the-street investigations and studio talk.
Jason and Grant discover ghostly evidence in a Florida lighthouse.
The team tracks paranormal activity in a 19th-century jail; the team investigates a case in the hometown of one of its members.
A man believes malevolent spirits are holding him captive in his home.
The team is asked to investigate a notoriously haunted hotel in Colorado.
The team travels to Tombstone, Ariz. to investigate the Birdcage Theater.
TAPS investigates the Copper Queen Hotel in Bisbee, Ariz.; the team attempts an investigation of the O.K. Corral.
TAPS travels to Vermont to investigate paranormal activity in a family's home; the team investigates the former West Virginia Penitentiary.
TAPS explores a Victorian mansion with a history of unexplained activity; the team investigates a bed and breakfast.
TAPS investigates paranormal activity at the hotel where "The Shining" was filmed.
The TAPS team travels to Ireland to investigate paranormal activity at Leap Castle.
TAPS explores a mysterious set of ruins in Ireland; an English tavern built over a 16th-century prison.
The team investigates a series of underground caves that were used for satanic rituals hundreds of years ago.
Two families require desperate assistance from TAPS after years of living with bizarre incidents in their homes.
A family fears the inexplicable movements of their antique dolls; a historic R.I. inn is the site of paranormal activity.
TAPS investigates the USS Lexington; paranormal activity at a historic building in the team's hometown.
A homeowner who lives near the location of the Manson murders claims that his house is haunted; TAPS investigates Charlie Chaplin Studios.
TAPS investigates an abandoned psychiatric hospital; the team investigates Seattle's underground tunnels.
The TAPS team investigates an old military base in San Francisco; TAPS helps a family who believes that a ghost is reporting to work at their business.
TAPS helps a family that experiences a rush of paranormal activity since the arrival of an orphaned niece; the team investigates Seattle's Moore Theatre.
TAPS investigates a church rectory; the team investigates the Sprague Mansion in Rhode Island.
TAPS investigates a bar in Salem, Mass.; Grant runs an investigation of the Hawthorne Hotel.
Jason and Grant reveal the findings from their live Halloween investigation.
TAPS take a look back at their most-memorable investigations.
The team investigates Fort Mifflin in Philadelphia; TAPS conducts the first investigation into a newly discovered underground holding cell.
The grisly history of Burlington County Jail, now a museum in Mount Holly, N.J., makes it a hotbed of paranormal activity; family members claim apparitions plague their youngest member.
The boys hunt for the spirits of pirates, spies and a headless horseman said to still roam the grounds of South Carolina's Fenwick Plantation.
The TWC investigates the tragically haunted Pennhurst Asylum, a location with a history of child patient abuse.
The team must find and trap the spirits of two suicidal patients at Hill View Manor in Western Pennsylvania.
The TWC team is the first to investigate an old confederate gunpowder and fabric factory, Sibley Mill.

The team is stranded on a river island and has 48 hours to investigate Fort Delaware, a former civil war POW camp that claimed the lives of one in four prisoners; the boys try to solve the ghostly feud of two civil war generals.
The boys are challenged to prove reports of a dark portal in the Bissman Building located in Mansfield, Ohio.
The team members board the U.S.S. Edson, a battleship that served in the Vietnam War, in an attempt to free the spirits purported to be trapped on the ship, including a poltergeist.
The crew members return to the Old South Pittsburg Hospital, the location of their very first paranormal investigation, where they hope to reveal the true identity of a menacing shadow figure.
The team work to reach the spirits that cling to the Peoria State Hospital before it is demolished.
The TWC visit Missouri State Penitentiary to banish the spirits of two sinister child killers that still infest its ghostly cellblocks.
While in Florida, the crew tries to contact a Seminole Indian Chief and a pair of doomed lovers that possibly haunt Castillo de San Marcos.
The team investigates Pauly Jail, where many unauthorized executions took place, in an attempt to contact two of the perished victims.
The team journeys to Preston Castle, California's first boy's reformatory school, to find answers to two of its most mysterious deaths.
The team goes to Kauai to investigate the abandoned Coco Palms Resort, built atop sacred land that spirits have roamed for centuries.
The TWC is called to investigate reports of paranormal activity on the grounds of the Old Crow Distillery.
In Tennessee, the team investigates a legendary prison, Brushy Mountain State Penitentiary; the team is taunted and attacked while battling ghosts during an electrical storm.
Over a 72-hour confinement period, Nick and Katrina learn not everyone has checked out of the Anderson Hotel.

Katrina and Nick investigate a Victorian mansion in Cleveland; the Franklin Castle was home to wealthy immigrant, Hannes Teidermann; Teidermann buried both his wife and one of his children while living in the mansion.

When Nick and Katrina arrive to investigate residual hauntings inside the long-shuttered Randolph County Infirmary in Winchester, Ind., they are alarmed to discover that there are still residents in the building.
As Nick and Katrina investigate the demonic past of a house in Hinsdale, N.Y., Nick gets caught in a psychological battle between good and evil.
Nick and Katrina are in Staten Island, New York to seek answers on who is haunting the infamous Kreischer Mansion.

Katrina Weidman and Nick Groff launch a special investigation of the Black Monk House in Yorkshire, England, feared for its violent poltergeist activity; Groff and Weidman plan to stay in the house for 100 hours.
Nick and Katrina spend 72 hours untangling the mysteries of Monroe Demon House, dealing with wraiths that are at odds with each other.
Nick and Katrina unlock the foreboding secrets of HMS Shrewsbury Prison in England, facing down over 200 years of executions, anger and tragedy.

Nick and Katrina visit a historic manor in Middleboro, Mass., to determine if it's unsafe for tourists; Katrina investigates hauntings beyond the house; the paranormal activity hits too close to home for Nick.
St. Ignatius Hospital in Colfax, Wash. has been abandoned since 2003, but Nick and Katrina soon realize they are not alone in the hospital.
Nick and Katrina set out to document the elusive shadow figures lurking within the expansive corridors of Waverly Hills Sanatorium in Louisville, Ky.
The team is called to Ohio to help a bereft mother identify the dark energy forcing her family to flee their home; Nick gets caught in a psychological battle between good and evil.

After her mother dies, a young woman returns to her hometown to take custody of her 12-year-old half sister. As she confronts her troubled past, she finds solace in an old classmate who gave up his sports dreams to paint watercolors.
In the 10 years before the creation of Mickey Mouse, Walt Disney struggles to master the art and business of animation.
Encouraged by his grandfather, a boy faces his fears and makes new friends at summer camp.
Ray Berry, an NSA analyst, becomes involved in a top-secret investigation when a computer virus crashes the government's computers.

Donna Lawrence, the survivor of a pit bull attack, adopts a pit bull mix puppy that was beaten, set afire and left for dead. Together, they learn to love and forgive as they seek justice and protection for all animals.
A struggling musician becomes a 12-year-old musical prodigy's guardian for a summer.
The airport on the island of Baltra in the Galápagos is about two hours from Quito, Ecuador.
As one of the ecosystems on Earth, the city was the latest to be born; it was created to meet human needs, but other forms of life are also endeavoring to find their own habitat here.
Eating animals to survive is one of the most basic, fundamental instincts.
The number of insects and their diversity makes them Earth's true masters.

A wild, jungle world lives on the shores of the Caribbean Sea; within the various channels of the tropical rivers, alligators and crocodiles swim and the fearsome jaguar searches for turtles on the region's virgin beaches.
A look at the amazing fauna and peculiar ecosystems in the Mediterranean.
Exploring the manufacture and use of cables, turnbuckles, ropes and anything else that can be used to tie, hang from or lasso.
Studying whether animals have pharmaceutical knowledge of the power of certain substances, including kaolin, poisonous insects and antidotes.

Freshwater ecosystems barely make up 1% of the Earth's surface, but 40% of the world's species live there; exploring the calm and dense waters of the wetlands, beginning with algae that are the basis for a remarkably active food chain.

From rocky mountain tops to unexplored cavernous labyrinths, the flow of water carves natural masterpieces into the landscape, and diverse and astonishing creatures live in these challenging environments.
The great grassy plains are like a giant restaurant.
Some cities are like an enormous buffet that's totally on the house.
In Phetchabun, Thailand, people and snakes [LIVE] within touching distance; Nirut embarks on a journey into a territory of king cobras, where hunting and killing is the norm.
Grassland is the Earth's second-largest ecosystem on land; China's grassland makes up an important part of the Eurasian Steppe.
Showcases the lives of a white-breasted waterhen and orphaned lesser whistling ducklings in the Singapore Botanic Gardens.
The fourth part of the series explores Singapore's forests; this multi-layered jungle is home to one of the least known primates in the world, flying dragons, mating snakes, and many more.
Malaysian superstar Michelle Yeoh returns to home to see her adopted orangutan for first time.
The Great Barrier Reef lies in the Coral Sea. Here wildlife flourishes in the pristine, tropical seas, home to the world's richest marine ecosystem.
Exploring the formation of the Iberian Peninsula.
The native Mediterranean wildlife and nature of Menorca; this Spanish island is a biosphere reserve since over 25 years, and is home to animals and plants that can be found nowhere else in the world.
On Mallorca, Yotam heads inland in search of authentic local cuisine; he discovers a wonderful larder of local ingredients, including suckling pig slow-cooked in a bread oven.
Classic fasolada; baked giant beans with honey and dill; braised chickpeas with pork shanks.
Greens pancake; vegetable and olive oil medley; pilaf of herbs and greens; orange-spiced semolina pudding cake with dried fruits and nuts.

Jeremy's pork sando with homemade tonkatsu sauce; Joe tries his hand at crispy chili beef; Jeremy cooks up scallops on the shore of Loch Ewe, while his sticky toffee pudding takes things to another level.

Jeremy starts with Sichuanese chicken; during his lesson, Joe tries to master the Wonton fold; on the Gower Peninsula, Jeremy makes spicy Xinjiang lamb and mixed veg skewers, followed by a spicy steamed plum pudding.
Celebrating the Día de los Muertos in Oaxaca City, Mexico.
Chilaquiles are a mainstay of Mexico City menus; chilaquiles with tangy tomatillo sauce; traditional chilaquiles with fried butternut strips and a complex pasilla chili sauce.
A taco tour, from simple vegetable preparations to suadero-style tacos; making tacos at home with homemade tortillas.
Queso fresco and quesillo; a simple dinner features cheese and salsa from the grill with a garden salad.

Chefs Tetsuya Wakuda, Justin Quek, and David Myers wine and dine at their upper echelon restaurants, share their love of food, introduce a few special dishes, and share one of their master class sessions.
Phil discovers the sleek Sakala restaurant in Tanjung Benoa, Bali; French Canadian chef Frederic Boulay shows Phil how to prepare some of his innovative signature dishes.
The restaurants and the culinary masters have more to share.
Chef Phillip steps into celebrity Japanese chef Tetsuya Wakuda's second outlet outside the original in Sydney, Waku Ghin.
Chef and owner Ryan Clift prepares more of the Tippling Club's signature dishes and drinks; Phil is treated to the restaurant's extensive degustation menu that typifies Tippling's dining experience.
Phil receives a seat of honor at the Chef's Table at Bacchanalia run by Chef Ivan Brehm; the restaurants Brehm has been a part of in his life have received a total of 11 Michelin Stars.
Inside The Westin in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, Phillip visits Prego where executive chef Aizat Hakim Feisal creates his impressive signature dishes; Phil also experiences a bit of Havana, Cuba.
The culinary energy at the Epicurean Market at Marina Bay Sands reaches a new level.
Sampling a variety of tastes, from German sausages ordered through the Internet, to the vines behind the wines of Austria.
In Darwin, Jason swims in a crocodile tank and visits Litchfield National Park; he also goes heli-pubbing, savors the delicious barra burger, then catches and cooks black pepper mud crab.
Tom cooks southern fried chicken-in-a-basket, as he pays homage to the perfect pub-garden meal.
Carolyn Scott-Hamilton, the Healthy Voyager, demonstrates how to prepare Vegan Vodka Sauce Valentine's Pasta with special guest Rikki Rockett.
Anthony Bourdain travels to Scotland for the traditional hearty breakfast, a deep-fried pizza, eggs and a Mars Bar.
Tony visits the Mall of America to discover what draws Americans to the food court; a local French chef will explain his approach to broaden Americans' palates.
Tony returns to his beloved Hanoi, Vietnam to visit his friend, Linh, for the Vietnamese lunar New Year holiday of Tet where they will taste exotic Vietnamese delicacies.

Jeremy starts with a fresh steamed salmon; Joe learns how to prepare sesame prawn toast; Jeremy makes Vietnamese lemongrass pork chops before baking classic chocolate chip cookies that contain a secret ingredient.

Jeremy's first dish is crispy belly pork; in the classroom, Joe Swash creates veggie Singapore noodles; Jeremy makes tea smoked duck and pancakes, followed by a Macanese egg tart as an accompaniment for a cup of tea.

Turkish cuisine channels cultural currents from all compass points, and Istanbul is the city to experience this cornucopia of unique culinary dishes; Ottolenghi dines at Asitane Restaurant, visits the Grand Bazaar and more.
Ann McClay teaches Catherine Fulvio how to make her son and daughter's favorite dishes, then Catherine travels to two states in America to teach them.
Catherine Fulvio meets Drimnagh woman Rosemary and learns how to make her daughter's favorite dish.

Ireland's top 6 chippers fry their way into the hearts and minds of Chef Dylan McGrath, takeaway expert Suzie Lee, and celebrity judge Deirdre O'Kane, to ultimately compete in the season's final cook off challenge.
Barbecued pork belly; house-cured pastrami; barbecued lamb shoulder with black dip; smoked Manhattan.
Cherry-smoked duck breasts; chiles rellenos; smoked mushroom bread pudding; Texas beef clod with mustard barbecue sauce.
Smoky mile-high pancake; candied bacon; beer can breakfast burgers; pork pastrami hash.
Plantation shrimp with spiced rum glaze; finger burner lamb chops; Catalan grilled tomato bread; smoked nectarine Bellinis.
Singapore-spiced halibut in banana leaves; whole-grilled branzino with Indonesian spices; coulibiac grilled salmon with smoked eggs; grilled oysters with Asian aromatics.
Spice-rubbed baby back ribs with chipotle bourbon barbecue sauce; Korean grilled beef short ribs; mystery box challenge -- lamb ribs.

Ottolenghi's Tunisian experience begins in an unusual open-air restaurant that shines a light on the region's extremely fresh seafood and continues at a popular seaside café; Tunisia is also a melting pot of many cultures, as you will see.
The magical inhabitants of a rainforest fight to save their home, which is threatened by logging and a polluting force of destruction called Heexus.

As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tenn., by murdering young women, and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.
John (Ryan Kwanten), a modern duelist, seeks a match with the reigning champion (Mickey Rourke) while Colt (Freida Pinto) seeks revenge for her dead brother.

A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

The two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton, and guest judge Lady Claire MacDonald OBE. There are standout dishes from both chefs making it a difficult contest to judge.

Three of the finest chefs from Wales are competing to be crowned champion. Two chefs are back for a second time: Phil Carmichael, from Cowbridge, South Wales, is executive chef at Berners Tavern in London, and Adam Bannister is chef and co-owner of Slice in his home city of Swansea. Adam was crowned Welsh champion last year so this year Phil is back with something to prove. He plans to go home raising the flag for Wales. The third chef is newcomer Andrew Birch, also from Swansea.

It is the fish course and newcomer Andrew Birch is confident - he is passionate about seafood. He is celebrating the cockle, which is harvested near his home city of Swansea. Adam Bannister has created an alter ego, Captain Bannister, for his modern take on the old boil-in-the-bag fish dinner, and Phil has chosen to revamp the classic prawn cocktail.

Phil Carmichael is serving up his version of an OBE, a refined take on onions, bacon and egg. Adam is planning to serve up wild boar on a spit, while Andrew turns up the heat when he combines strong Japanese flavours with a traditional roast.

It is the dessert course and one chef will go home. Phil Carmichael is determined it won't be him but not everything is going to plan when he tackles his "Cup of Tea for Ma'am". One of the accompaniments to his Earl Grey panna cotta just won't work. He has to make a difficult decision.

It is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Wales are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, blogger and food writer Rosie Birkett.

Three newcomers are competing to become regional champion. Daniel Smith, a former head chef for the Roux brothers, now runs his own restaurant in his beloved home county of Norfolk. Andrew Scott's worked with the best in the business, and he's concentrating on telling powerful stories as well as delivering perfect flavours. Danny Gill is a former head chef at Daniel Clifford's two-star restaurant Midsummer House.

It is the fish course and the chefs are using some of the UK's best seafood: lobster, salmon and Cornish crab. Danny Gill is a chef who likes to use the very latest equipment to create the most intense flavours. He's going to great lengths to maximise the taste of his cucumber consommé, and it is causing a lot of interest in the kitchen.

Two chefs are cooking venison. Danny Gill is making a venison wellington, inspired by his Dad, a former RAF chef who has served up wellington for royalty at many air force banquets, while Andrew Scott has sourced his venison from the Queen's Scottish estate, Balmoral.

This week three chefs from the central region are fighting to be crowned champion. One competitor will go home, only the two highest scoring chefs will make it through to the judging chamber. Danny Gill is facing his toughest day yet, choosing to make a staggering eight elements for his imaginative dessert.

The Central region's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort, for the very first time. Joining them in the chamber is guest judge Enam Ali MBE, a food entrepreneur who set up The British Curry Awards.

Three of the most exciting talents from London and the South East region are competing for a place in the national finals. Head chef Mark Froydenlund runs Marcus Wareing's two-star restaurant. Russell Bateman is head chef at The Grove in Hertfordshire and Ronnie Murray who heads up the Hix Restaurant group.

It is the fish course and chef Russell Bateman is celebrating the diversity of his beloved home town of London - by combining lobster with jerk spices for an ambitious fish course with seven key elements. Ronnie Murray's taking a risk with an ingredient which is close to the veteran judge's heart and is planning to serve it at three different temperatures, warm, deep-fried and frozen. And two Michelin-starred Mark Froydenlund is planning a novel way to present his dish.

It's the all-important main course and returning contender Mark Froydenlund is banking on it being his strongest dish. Russell Bateman is creating a beef dish, and Ronnie Murray's mixing a crown of lamb with a curried filling.

It's the dessert course and the final chance for three of London and South East's most competitive and talented chefs to get through to the judging chamber, today the veteran judge will send one chef home.

It is the head to head and the two highest scoring chefs from the London and South East region are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort. Joining this week as guest judge is Kevin Gould, an award-winning food writer.

Mini Patel is back for a second attempt at the north-east regional title, but he is competing against two young newcomers, Tommy Banks and Chris Archer. In 2015 Mini went home after the dessert course, so he is hoping to keep better control of his nerves this year.

It is the fish course and two chefs, Tommy and Mini, have very similar ingredients - both are cooking mackerel. However, Mini is trying an original beetroot sorbet while Tommy is using wild woodruff and oyster leaf from his own garden. Chris Archer has chosen the king of the sea, turbot, but there is controversy in the kitchen.

It is the main course of the north-east region and overnight there has been a dramatic development. It is a tough and emotional day for the chefs as they react to the news, but they battle on in a bid to present a perfect dish with venison and Wagyu-Angus beef - the meat of the day.

It is a highly emotional day for one of the chefs as he prepares a dish which is inspired by and a tribute to his own great Briton, his late grandfather. However, all does not go to plan, and the chef ends up making one key element three times in a bid to achieve perfection.

The two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton for the very first time. Joining them as guest judge is John Williams MBE, the executive head chef at The Ritz, the only hotel to hold a royal warrant for banqueting.

It is Chris McGowan's third time; however, he is facing tough competition from Mark Abbott, head chef at Daniel Clifford's two Michelin-star restaurant, Midsummer House, and also from Eddie Attwell who has just completed a year as head chef at Ardtara Country House in Upperlands.

Mark Abbott is pushing himself again plating up a complex fish course of the very finest produce. He is calling it Shellsational but at the last minute he forgets a key element. Returning chef Chris McGowan is refining cod and chips and Eddie Attwell is getting classical with the king of the sea, turbot. The repartee is relentless as the chefs jostle for top place on the leader board. Once again there is plenty of emotion as the veteran chef delivers the scores.

It is the main course and returning Chef Chris McGowan is feeling confident, but part of his dish involves making his own venison sausages to serve with a venison rack, and getting it all done in time is straining his emotions. Eddie Attwell is also serving the meat but with a traditional Northern Irish dish called Dock pudding. Mark Abbott is pushing himself again; he is using wagyu beef and serving it with tongue and corn cooked in a variety of ways.

The three chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking their desserts and one chef is on course for a historic score, he could beat his boss - a veteran of GBM - and achieve more marks than anyone has done throughout the history of the competition.

It is the head-to-head. The two highest scoring chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, restaurant critic and Editor-at-Large of the Independent, Amol Rajan.

It is the national finals of 'Great British Menu'. Before cooking starts the eight champions are called to London's Southbank to get a sight of the prize, the chance to cook at a banquet held at the Palace of Westminster, in celebration of everyday Great Britons honoured by the Queen. It has a huge impact on every one of the chefs, each is determined to do all he can to get a dish to the banquet.

It's day two of the national finals, and the eight champions cook their fish courses. This year's challenge has been to produce dishes that are a lasting legacy to the New Elizabethan Age. They must showcase the transformation in British cuisine during the Queen's historic 64-year reign.

It's main course day, the one course every chef wants to cook at the banquet. The chefs' dishes will be judged by Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton along with guest judge John Williams MBE, executive chef of The Ritz.

It's the final day of the competition, and the last chance for the eight champions to get one of their dishes to the banquet for Queen Elizabeth II's Great Britons. Judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton will judge the dessert course and then decide on the banquet menu to be served at the Houses of Parliament. Joining them in the judging chamber is Grace Dent, restaurant critic, journalist and author.

The winning chefs arrive at the Palace of Westminster to cook for the Banquet of Great Britons. The chefs have been selected because their dishes showcase contemporary British cuisine and demonstrate the transformation in British food during the Queen's historic reign.

The three chefs meet their surprise veteran judge and cook their starters. A dish celebrating childhood summer memories takes on a complicated courgette dish and a technically tricky take on the cucumber sandwich.

The atmosphere in the kitchen gets even more intense as all the chefs take risks with their dishes. Mike Reid, executive chef at M Restaurants in London, shocks when he pairs his fish with some highly unusual flavours.

The kitchen is filled with smoke as the three chefs prepare their summer-themed mains. Selin Kiazim is in her element, preparing a feast inspired by the summer barbecues. Mike Reid uses wagyu beef. Tom Kemble uses juniper branches to smoke his meat.
All three chefs are feeling the pressure as they attempt their technical summer desserts. With only the two highest scorers going through to the regional final, who will be sent home?

The two remaining London and the South East chefs must cook their entire taste of summer menus again. They're hoping to impress the formidable panel of Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and restaurateur Andi Oliver.
The chefs have been challenged to create outstanding dishes that capture a 'taste of summer'. Their menus must reflect the tastes, smells and colours of everybody's favourite time of year.

It's the fish course and, with a seafood specialist in the kitchen, the competition is stepping up a gear. Tom is hoping he'll be able to elevate the humble mackerel to the standards required for the 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon banquet.

With a refined summer barbecue going up against a traditional Cornish speciality and a historic 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon related recipe, who will come out on top? Andy Clatworthy is using his passion for historical cooking to reinvent a dish.
Eb needs fast cash, so he involves the Douglases in a moneymaking scheme.
While rummaging through an old trunk, Lisa and Oliver find evidence of a 19th-century romance.
An eccentric Hooterville inventor produces the world's first milk-making machine.
Lisa's mother arrives at the farm for a three-week-long visit.
Arnold may be the sole heir to a meat-packing tycoon's estate.
Arnold needs to prove he's the rightful heir to an eccentric tycoon's estate.
Hooterville prepares a welcome for Arnold, but the situation gets out of control.
Problems caused by unpaved roads force Lisa and Oliver to lodge a complaint with the state.
Fortuneteller Lisa predicts a stranger entering Oliver's life.
Oliver's barn is transformed into a new center for the town's youth.
Oliver speaks at a high school, and finds himself the target of a teenager's advances.

Unable to support his family on a bus driver's salary, World War II veteran Edwin Boyd finds a way to combine his love of acting and his need for money by robbing banks.

Living a life of isolation and frustration, a young man develops an unexpected friendship with a reclusive heiress. When that relationship meets its tragic end, his loneliness and anger culminates into the most nihilistic and heinous of acts.
Swedish journalists document the black power movement in America.

The town of Adel, Ga., is rocked by a brutal robbery homicide, and locals quickly point to an outsider as the killer; over 20 years later, new evidence raises the startling question if an innocent man is serving life for another man's crime.

When a beloved chiropractor in Sauquoit, N.Y., dies suddenly under strange circumstances, investigators discover she's been murdered with a rare poison; the killer could only be someone she knew closely, and the case divides the town.

A young woman in St. Augustine, Fla., with everything to live for is found shot to death with the gun belonging to her boyfriend, a deputy sheriff; he says it was suicide, but her family believes it was murder.

When an immigrant couple who settled in the Tennessee town of Cookeville is executed in their sleep and their house set on fire, investigators identify a suspect with motive; in their rush to make an arrest, they may have gotten the wrong man.
In rural Shelbyville, Ky., a body is found in the river; years go by until the police catch the killer, but some in town question if the suspect is even capable of committing the crime.

When a 22-year-old dancer goes missing, the men of the neighboring town who frequented the club she worked at become the suspect pool; wealth and status may protect a killer; a determined police officer works the case.

After a woman is found shot in her bathroom, officials launch a death investigation to determine if it was suicide - as her husband claimed - or murder; years later, the case remains open, and the town still has questions.
A young single mother disappears without a trace; an investigation suggests she abandoned her children, while her family spends years proving she was murdered and finding her killers.
A man claims he shot his daughter's estranged husband, Christian Griggs, in self-defense; after investigators close the case, Christian's family discovers evidence that the killing was not justified.

A beloved town doctor perishes in a deadly house fire - which investigators conclude was arson; but after securing a murder conviction, the prosecutor doubts his own evidence, and joins the fight to free an innocent man.
Cold case investigators, looking into a shocking double murder, elicit a series of confessions from a group of teens; years later, the teens recant their statements.

A criminal defense attorney, known for uncovering corruption, finds himself on trial; accused of a complex murder-for-hire plot, along with eight others, he fights to clear his name and show the many holes in the state's case.

A couple is found brutally murdered in their home; investigators learn that the last person to see them alive had secrets of his own; some question whether prejudice led police to arrest the wrong man.

A dentist is brazenly killed by a masked gunman; the media reports salacious details as investigators uncover a sinister plot led by the dentist's wife and stepson; a private investigator shares a startling alternate theory.
One of the most famous cases in modern history ends with a verdict that shakes the nation; questions arise over who is responsible, and what part trial consultants and the media play in the outcome.

As a rebellious and motherless child, Ophelia is taken into Elsinore Castle by Queen Gertrude as one of her most trusted ladies-in-waiting. Soon enough, Ophelia captures the affections of the young Prince Hamlet. A passionate romance secretly kindles between the two as the kingdom is on the brink of war amidst its own political intrigue and betrayal. When Hamlet's father is murdered and the prince begins to unravel, Ophelia sharply navigates the rules of power in Denmark.
A reclusive Englishwoman opens her heart to a young evacuee as World War II rages across the channel.

British aristocrat Sir Percy Blakeney (Anthony Andrews) appears to be a vain and shallow man, but, in the guise of his alter ego, the Scarlet Pimpernel, he is a courageous swordsman. As the Pimpernel, Blakeney works to free Gallic nobility from death during the fervor of the French Revolution. However, Blakeney's life of luxury with his beautiful bride, Marguerite (Jane Seymour), is threatened when the French send sinister operative Chauvelin (Ian McKellen) to stop the Pimpernel at any cost.
Ali Khan Shirvanshir, the male descendant of a royal Muslim family, falls in love with the beautiful Nino Kipiani, a Georgian princess who is Christian, while he is in Azerbaijan during World War I.
After a cyber engineer and her family are killed in a targeted attack, Colin and Bill rush to stop the culprits before they strike again.

American college student Amanda Knox embarks on her study abroad trip in Italy; the morning before Amanda is supposed to leave on a romantic excursion with her new Italian boyfriend, Raffaele Sollecito, things take a sinister turn.
Under mounting pressure, the police try to break Amanda and Raffaele; Edda races to reunite with her daughter.
As Amanda, Raffaele and Patrick Lumumba enter prison, Giuliano Mignini, their prosecutor, continues to build his case against them while the media's reporting turns Amanda into a monster.
A wrench is thrown in Mignini's case and the search for a new suspect, Rudy Guede, begins; as the highly anticipated trial unfolds, Amanda's choices continue to be scrutinized by the press.

In Modesto, Calif., a fight at a marijuana dispensary ends with a stabbing; in Bay St. Louis, Miss., a 22-year-old rapper is delighted by his mugshot, but not by the possibility of spending his birthday in jail.
A man in Modesto is apprehended by a K9 unit while fleeing from police; another is arrested while his family dog bleeds in their backyard; a woman arrested on DUI continuously argues with deputies.

In Modesto, a woman is brought in for her 14th felony charge, while a young man is arrested after not having reflectors on his bicycle; in Virginia Beach, a man dances his way to the drunk tank and a woman gets a surprise embezzlement charge.

A woman in Hancock is picked up on traffic warrants, but when she is booked, a surprising charge threatens her freedom; in Virginia Beach, a man busted for being drunk in public requires medical attention.

In November 1999, 16-year-old Julie Surprenant disappears without a trace; she is last seen at a bus stop just meters from her back door in the Montreal suburb of Terrebonne, but somehow never makes it home.

Just days away from a family Easter dinner in 2019, a young single mom and her 22-month-old daughter disappear; days pass and their loved ones grow concerned and contact the police; investigators say all footprints of life have come to a sudden end.
Shopkeeper Imran Ashgar is shot dead in his store in Columbus, Ohio; with the killers on the run, detectives are in a race against time to capture them before they strike again.
Ray and Fraser enter the unknown when a derelict has visions about a kidnapping; Ray is in a frenzy trying to find out if Fraser has slept with his sister.
Fraser revives a relationship with a woman he once arrested; when her ex-partner turns up dead, she vanishes and Fraser is a suspect.
When a popular musician bursts into flames during a concert, the CSIs expose the dark side of stardom.
A bizarre case involving a man who was chopped in half baffles the CSIs; Natalia's injury puts her and Ryan in jeopardy.

After a young boy is abandoned by his parents, he begins to have dark urges; a disturbing social media message leads to a murder investigation.

A 16-year-old girl who lives across the street from an elementary school begins shooting at students from her window; in May 2007, experts are called to investigate a bloody crime scene in Manheim Township.

As the trial winds down, experts attempt to recreate John's death, the defense brings in one final witness and closing arguments grip the nation; Karen, emotional after a long haul, anxiously awaits her fate; the jury returns with an unexpected note.

Intruders shoot wealthy jeweler Ted Shaughnessy at his home in Austin, Texas; investigators wonder if it was a random attack or a robbery gone wrong; as they dig deeper, police suspect it wasn't a stranger killing at all.
Police struggle to solve the heartbreaking murder of a talented young woman, but it will take years to realize that the clue to unlock the mystery is hidden within the crime scene evidence.

When police find the lifeless body of a young mother, her husband becomes the prime suspect; when an in-depth investigation against him stalls, it raised a critical question, had police been focused on the wrong man all along?
A killer guns down a man during a home invasion; the evidence points to a well-planned crime; can police find who's behind the attack?
Police retrace the steps of a young woman's preparations for a romantic Valentine's dinner that ended in her murder; hidden in the crime scene is the clue that unlocks the mystery.

When Sara learns of her mother's murder, she slowly begins to realize who her father truly is, unearthing her family's dirty secrets along the way.

Chev Chelios (Jason Statham), a hit man wanting to go straight, lets his latest target slip away, then he awakes the next morning to a phone call that informs him he has been poisoned and has only an hour to live unless he keeps adrenaline coursing through his body while he searches for an antidote.

After surviving an incredible plunge to near-certain death, Chev Chelios is abducted by Chinese mobsters. Waking up three months later, Chev finds that his nearly indestructible heart has been replaced with a battery-operated device that requires regular jolts of electricity, or it will fail. Chev escapes from his captors, reunites with his lover, Eve, and sets out on a frantic chase through Los Angeles to get his real heart back.

A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

Luke Wright is a two-bit cage fighter, until the day he throws a fixed match. In retaliation, the Russian mob murders his family and destroys his life. Though alone and haunted by grief, Luke springs into action to save a Chinese girl (Catherine Chan) from the same gangsters who killed his family -- and lands in the middle of a high-stakes war. The girl is no ordinary child; she's a math prodigy who holds in her head a numerical code for which various factions are ready to kill.

Alex Cross (Tyler Perry) works as a detective/psychologist for the Detroit Police Department along with his lifelong friend, Tommy Kane (Edward Burns), and detective Monica Ashe (Rachel Nichols). Cross' latest case puts him on a collision course with Picasso (Matthew Fox), a cunning serial killer whose ultimate target is multinational industrialist Giles Mercier (Jean Reno). Cross must find a way inside Picasso's head not only to catch the killer but also to stem the violent urges Cross feels.
A U.S. marshal boards a small plane to transfer a government witness to New York. As they cross the Alaskan wilderness, tensions start to rise as not everyone on the flight is who they appear to be.

Tragedy strikes on April 15, 2013, when two bombs explode during the Boston Marathon. In the aftermath of the attack, police Sgt. Tommy Saunders (Mark Wahlberg), FBI Special Agent Richard DesLauriers (Kevin Bacon) and Commissioner Ed Davis (John Goodman) join courageous survivors, first responders and other investigators in a race against the clock to hunt down the suspects and bring them to justice.

Once a narcotics officer in the LAPD, Ray Owens settles into a peaceful life as sheriff of Sommerton Junction, a quiet border town. That peace is shattered when Gabriel Cortez, a vicious crime lord, escapes from FBI custody and speeds toward Ray's town with a band of mercenaries. Federal agents prepare to capture Cortez. Ray is at first reluctant to get involved, but he soon finds he must rally his team and take matters into his own hands.
A Mountie tracks mine robbers in the 1890s Canada.
In their first cinematic outing, Red Ryder and his Indian sidekick help a newspaper publisher clean up her town.
A boy raised by his servant vows to take revenge on the ranchers who killed his parents.

In Abilene, Kan., Marshal Dan Mitchell (Randolph Scott) contends with unruly cattlemen and a group of determined homesteaders intending to settle on government land bordering the town. Hoping to rid the town of the farmers, the cowboys set fire to their camp, and a desperado murders a homesteader, but Dan refuses to allow them revenge. Joining a posse under a crooked sheriff, and with the help of singer Rita (Ann Dvorak) and a merchant, Dan forces a peaceful showdown between the factions.

At one time not so long ago, Milt Brower (William Farnum) and Pa Jackson (Stanley Andrews) were peaceable partners in a thriving cattle business. Now divided, the two are engaged in an embittered land dispute that turns ugly when Jackson accuses Brower of the dastardly crime of cattle rustling. Faithful cowboy Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) steps in to defend his old friend Brower, making him a hero in the eyes of Brower's doting and dainty daughter, Claire (Mary Hart).
A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) clears the outlaw (Donald Barry) and his gang of a bank robbery done by bankers.

Rex (Rex Allen) and Slim (Slim Pickens) journey to Colorado, where Slim is expecting to claim the estate of the departed Zeke Reynolds. But the will also includes Jacqueline Reynolds (Mary Ellen Kay) and the evil Hurley siblings (June Vincent, Fred Graham). The Hurleys, who assumed they were the sole heirs, plan to use the estate's forests for a timber business. They will stop at nothing, including murder, to make the land theirs, but Rex and Slim are willing to fight for justice.
A Texas Ranger pretends he has been discharged from service to trick outlaws into accepting him into their gang.

After the Civil War, cavalryman Capt. Hunt tries to strike peace with Acoma, a Native American chief. However, Judge Wilcox and others provoke Acoma, arresting him and shooting his men, prompting revenge from the chief. In the ensuing battles, one of Acoma's sons is killed, enraging him further. Hunt must save Cherry, a dance hall girl caught up in the commotion, and try to find a way to end the bloody conflict with Acoma.

Former Texas Ranger Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), now an attorney, is called back into law enforcement by his old pals Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and Panhandle Perkins (Guy Wilkerson), who want his help recovering some stolen gold. An outlaw they put away years before is about to be paroled, and they reckon he will make a beeline for his stashed loot. Panhandle adopts a fake identity and befriends the robber in prison. After he discovers the convict's treasure map, the race is on.

Plucky widow Elinore Randall (Conchata Ferrell) and her young daughter, Jerrine (Megan Folson), travel to Montana at the dawn of the 20th century so that Elinore can take a job running the household of gruff, undemonstrative rancher Clyde Stewart (Rip Torn). Though the Wild West days have faded into the recent past, life in the mountainous area remains difficult. Still, Elinore and Clyde form a quiet but loving bond in the face of backbreaking labor and unexpected adversity.
A gunsmith (Lane Chandler) offers to fix outlaws' guns if they release their hostage to him.
Posing as an Asian, a Washington agent goes after a gem-smuggling outlaw gang.

Loner U.S. Marshal John Travers (John Wayne) foils the hold-up of a stagecoach, rescuing young woman Anita Matlock (Verna Hillie) from the clutches of the crooks and helping her back to town. But there, the sheriff is gunned down by bandits, so Travers starts investigating and connects the murder to a gang, led by an unidentified bandit known as the Shadow, who's been running the town ragged for some time. Travers then makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down the Shadow.
The Lone Rider (Bob Livingston) and his sidekick (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) crunch an Arizona grazing-land monopoly.

After a long battle with Gen. Miguel Sebastian of Mexico, Capt. McKane (Jim Davis) and his troops successfully take over a small town in Southern California. Despite the Mexican settlers' claim that the land is rightfully theirs, McKane, Sgt. Pardee (Lee Van Cleef) and a gang of mercenaries drive them from their homes. When U.S. Judge Ward Young (Louis Jean Heydt) and his lawman son, Faron (Faron Young), come to town, they're shocked by McKane's ruthless leadership and vow to set things right.

Larry Sutton (Randolph Scott) becomes chief engineer at the Ballard radium mine after the mysterious death of the former chief. Asked by the sheriff to assist in the investigation of the death, Larry learns that his own brother-in-law, as well as the nephew (Howard Wilson) and niece (Kathleen Burke) of the mine owner, Jim Ballard (George F. Marion), are all suspects. When Mrs. Ballard (Florence Roberts) returns from a trip and is not allowed to see Jim, Larry takes an active role in the case.

Sergei Kowalski, a mercenary only out for himself and a few dollars, joins up with a Mexican peasant-turned-revolutionary, Paco Roman, when the price is right. No longer content to toil for the rich and powerful, Roman plans to bring a new order to Mexico by force with his small ragtag group. While Roman and Kowalski are outnumbered facing the Mexican army, they also have to contend with Curly, a vengeful killer out for blood.

At the beginning of the Mexican Revolution in 1913, greedy bandit Juan Miranda and idealist John H. Mallory, an Irish Republican Army explosives expert on the lam from the British, fall in with a band of revolutionaries plotting to strike a national bank. When it turns out that the government has been using the bank as a hiding place for illegally detained political prisoners, who are freed by the blast, Miranda becomes a revolutionary hero against his will.

After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault.

Brandt Ruger (Gene Hackman) is a rich cattle rancher. He has a bad relationship with his wife, Melissa (Candice Bergen), whom he treats like a possession. While Brandt is away from home on a hunting trip, Frank Calder (Oliver Reed), a brazen outlaw, kidnaps Melissa and holds her for ransom. Frank, however, treats Melissa better than her own husband does, and before long she begins to develop feelings for him. When Brandt returns, he's enraged and vows to take violent revenge against Frank.

Gunfighter Wild Bill Hickok (Jeff Bridges) travels the frontier, gaining fame and enemies in roughly equal measure. He sometimes meets up with his friend and occasional lover, Calamity Jane (Ellen Barkin), and he headlines for a while in a traveling circus. Along the way, he meets Susannah (Diane Lane), his one true love, but spurns her for the outlaw life. With his health deteriorating, Bill rides into Deadwood, S.D., as his past catches up to him.

Matthew Quigley (Tom Selleck) is an American rifleman who travels to the Australian outback to answer a help-wanted ad calling for a sharpshooter. When Quigley meets his employer, Elliott Marston (Alan Rickman), he's appalled to discover the job involves killing Aboriginal Australians. The two men fight, and when Quigley is knocked out, Marston leaves him and a local crazy woman (Laura San Giacomo) to die in a remote part of the Outback. They're rescued, however, and plot their revenge.

Gunman Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) is an American exiled in Mexico for the revenge killing of his father's assassin. Brady, a henchman of the ruthless Castro crime family, travels across the border to Texas to negotiate the sale of black market rifles. When a broken leg delays Brady's return to Mexico, U.S. Army Maj. Colton (Gary Merrill) and Texas Ranger Capt. Rucker (Albert Dekker) attempt to enlist Brady as a sharpshooter in their war against the Apaches.

Fleeing the scene of a gruesome gunfight in Mexico, Billy Young (Robert Walker) arrives in the small town of Lordsburg, where he is promptly deputized by local sheriff Ben Kane (Robert Mitchum). Kane takes the troubled young man under his wing, hoping to reform his lawless ways. As the bond between the two men grows stronger, Kane recruits Young for a particularly personal assignment: to help bring to justice Frank Boone (John Anderson), a vicious outlaw responsible for the death of his son.

Foolish life insurance salesman Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) commits his biggest blunder yet when he unwittingly offers a six-figure policy to notorious gunslinger Jesse James (Wendell Corey). Furious, his boss orders him to repurchase the policy. James, however, parries Farnsworth's attempts with ease, robbing and humiliating him. But when James' latest scheme pairs the patsy with the bandit's sweetheart, Cora Lee Collins (Rhonda Fleming), Farnsworth and Cora begin falling in love.

The four McDade brothers stage a successful heist -- except that three of them are killed. When their wives and mother learn that only one of the young men survived with the loot, they are eager to find out which one. Slick traveler Dan Kehoe catches wind of this strange situation and decides to charm the women in hopes of eventually enjoying the spoils. Before long, however, the lonely females begin competing for Dan, disintegrating into a cut-throat battle royal for his heart.

Three cowboy movie stars from the silent era -- Dusty Bottoms (Chevy Chase), Lucky Day (Steve Martin) and Ned Nederlander (Martin Short) -- are fired when one of their movies bombs. In what seems to be a career-saving offer, young Mexican woman Carmen (Patrice Martinez) offers them a high-paying gig in her village. The three jump at the opportunity, expecting to do their typical act, but Carmen believes they are really heroes and asks them to rid her village of bad guy El Guapo (Alfonso Arau).
An aging rodeo rider (James Coburn) thinks more of himself than he does of his wife (Lois Nettleton), son and best friend (Slim Pickens).

Determined single woman Ella Connors (Jane Fonda) struggles to maintain her ranch despite constant attempts by Jacob "J.W." Ewing (Jason Robards), the aging owner of the neighboring ranch, to coerce her into selling. When oil companies begin pressuring both ranchers to allow drilling, Ella's position becomes even more perilous. Though Ella thinks she's scrappy enough to fight them on her own, her chances get better with the arrival of hunky war veteran Frank "Buck" Athearn (James Caan).

While battling a trio of rampaging giants, the legendary half-demon Hellboy encounters Nimue the Blood Queen, an ancient resurrected sorceress who's out to avenge a past betrayal. Suddenly caught in a clash between the supernatural and the human, Hellboy soon becomes hell-bent on stopping Nimue without triggering the end of the world.

A powerful Cimmerian warrior, Conan carves a bloody path across the land of Hyboria on a personal vendetta. That soon turns into an epic battle against evil, for Conan's mortal enemy, Khalar Zym, seeks the legendary Mask of Acheron. The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it.

The survival of mankind hangs in the balance when Set, the merciless god of darkness, usurps Egypt's throne and plunges the prosperous empire into chaos and conflict. Hoping to save the world and rescue his true love, a defiant mortal named Bek forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus. Their battle against Set and his henchmen takes them into the afterlife and across the heavens for an epic confrontation.

To save his homeland from certain doom, a kung fu master must escape from the maniacal James Hook in order to send his daughter a secret talisman that will allow her to control a massive and mythical dragon.

In this sci-fi/fantasy sequel, Connor MacLeod (Christopher Lambert) has become an elderly man after losing his immortality. Living in a bleak future where the world is protected from solar radiation by a massive shield, MacLeod regains his youth when he kills two assassins from his home planet. This results in an ongoing battle with the villainous and powerful Gen. Katana (Michael Ironside), but MacLeod receives help when the noble Juan Ramirez (Sean Connery) returns.
A warrior leads an uprising against the tyrannical ruler of the planet Aradius.

Tough and chiseled Ray Breslin (Sylvester Stallone) knows how to infiltrate a prison -- and bust out of one. His latest job leads to a double-cross, leaving him stuck in a high-tech facility with the worst that society has to offer. Luckily for Ray, he meets Emil Rottmayer (Arnold Schwarzenegger), an inmate who secretly helps him hatch a plot to win his freedom. Only sadistic warden Hobbes (Jim Caviezel) stands in the way of the two men successfully making it out alive.

Ray Breslin manages an elite team of security specialists trained in the art of breaking people out of the world's most impenetrable prisons. Ray Breslin and his team of security experts fight to rescue Breslin's girlfriend and a tech mogul's daughter from a formidable prison known as Devil's Station.

To celebrate his 30th birthday, Tyler and his six friends try an escape room challenge. The special mission for escaping a room in one hour starts, and the members immediately notice that the challenge is deadly and difficult.

Mike Enslin is a successful author who enjoys worldwide acclaim debunking supernatural phenomena -- before he checks into the Dolphin Hotel, that is. Ignoring the warnings of the hotel manager, he learns the meaning of real terror when he spends the night in a reputedly haunted room.

Rancher Clay Hardin (Errol Flynn) has discovered that local saloon owner Roy Stuart (Paul Kelly) is selling cattle that doesn't belong to him, including some of Clay's own stolen stock. Armed with a tally book that proves it, Hardin now finds himself the target of Stuart's posse of gunslingers, who will stop at nothing to prevent Hardin from delivering the evidence to the proper authorities. With no one to help him except a few of his friends, Hardin has to fight for his cattle, and his life.

In 1872, Dodge City, Kansas was the epicenter of cattle drives and lawlessness. Run by Jeff Surrett (Bruce Cabot), Dodge City isn't safe for anyone or anything. When Wade Hatton (Errol Flynn) arrives for a cattle drive, he's moved by the violent death of a young boy to take up the post of sheriff and take back the town from Surrett and his cohorts. But first he must contend with the rowdy townsfolk who, having been so long without law, desire to take the law into their own hands.

Johnny Cobb (James Stewart) is the part-time sheriff in a small, rundown town, trying to stretch his meager salary to provide for his growing family. Poor Cobb isn't much of a gunman, and he isn't particularly suited for fighting, but he's the man in charge when a gang of bandits led by Bob Larkin (Henry Fonda) rides into town. The tension rises as the bandits make themselves at home in Cobb's town, but when a gunfight breaks out, Cobb finds himself pushed to the limit.

After he is abandoned in the desert without water, Cable Hogue (Jason Robards) wanders for days until he finds a supply of water in a muddy ditch. Determining that the spot is the only spring in the area, Cable decides to start a business offering water to passing stagecoaches. Aided by his new friend, Joshua (David Warner), and a prostitute named Hildy (Stella Stevens), Cable builds a successful business. However, when motorcars start to pass, Cable realizes his trade is down to its last days.
Shenandoah saves a man who knows his true identity.

Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.

Undercover federal marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is suspected by the local sheriff, Jake (George Hayes), of stealing the town's payroll, but his suspicions are sidelined when young Betty Mason (Eleanor Hunt) announces that her father, an important businessman, has been murdered. Without him, supplies will not reach town, and homesteaders will starve. When town leader Malgrove (Edward Peil) offers to buy the locals out, John and Jake get suspicious, and uncover a land-grabbing conspiracy.

John Scott (John Wayne) is a rodeo rider, assisted by his buddy Kansas Charlie (Eddy Chandler). But while the duo is settling a debt with their promoter, Farnsworth (Henry Hall), thieves Pete (Al Ferguson) and Jim (Paul Fix) murder and rob Farnsworth and manage to pin the crimes on John and Charlie. The accused then flee, assume two new identities, take up with a shopkeeper named Anne (Mary Kornman) and set out to clear their names and bring the real killers to justice.

Tracy Powell (David Wayne) is an Indiana farmer with an insatiable thirst for gold. Inspired by the California Gold Rush, Powell sets out for Stockton, Calif., leaving behind the only life he has ever known. But, failing to find his fortune, he returns to Indiana, farming and the loving arms of his girlfriend, Julie (Marcia Henderson). Sadly, even the birth of his son cannot assuage his gold fever. Before long, Powell has once again headed west -- this time leaving behind a wife and child.

Kind-hearted, fatherly John Chisum (John Wayne) owns a large ranch in Lincoln County, New Mexico, in the 1870s. With the help of his faithful sidekick, Pepper (Ben Johnson), and a hot-headed young ranch hand nicknamed Billy the Kid (Geoffrey Deuel), Chisum does battle with underhanded land developer Lawrence Murphy (Forrest Tucker). Having bought up most of the nearby town and appointed his own corrupt sheriff (Bruce Cabot), Murphy now has his eye on Chisum's ranch.
